en: Fort de Bilt, also known as Fort op de Biltstraat, is one of the defensive works of the Nieuwe Hollandse Waterlinie in the municipality of Utrecht.

name: Fort De Gagel
en: Fort De Gagel is a fort in Utrecht. The fort was built between 1819 and 1821 as part of the Nieuwe Hollandse Waterlinie. The fort consists of several national monuments.

name: Frans Hendriksz Oetgensbrug
en: The Frans Hendricksz. Oetgensbrug (bridge 76) is a permanent bridge in Amsterdam-Centrum. It is located on the western quay of the Amstel and spans the Prinsengracht. The bridge is the last bridge of the Prinsengracht before it flows into the same Amstel. The bridge is also on the southeastern border of the Amsterdam canal belt.

name: Frans Hendriksz Oetgensbrug
en: The Frans Hendricksz. Oetgensbrug (bridge 76) is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-Centrum. It lies in the western quay of the Amstel and spans the Prinsengracht. It is the last bridge of the Prinsengracht before that canal flows into the Amstel, and marks the south-eastern edge of Amsterdam's canal ring. It has been a municipal monument since 1995.

name: Fré Cohenbrug
en: The Fré Cohenbrug is a fixed bridge with diving platform in Watergraafsmeer, Amsterdam. The bridge is located in the Zaaiersweg in Betondorp and spans the Molenwetering, which comes from under the Rinus Michelsbrug in the Middenweg. That Molenwetering also forms a ring ditch westward around the Nieuwe Oosterbegraafplaats.

name: Fré Cohenbrug
en: The Fré Cohenbrug is a fixed bridge with a culvert in Watergraafsmeer, Amsterdam. It lies in the Zaaiersweg in Betondorp and spans the Molenwetering, which comes from under the Rinus Michelsbrug in the Middenweg. Westward that watercourse also forms a ring ditch around the Nieuwe Oosterbegraafplaats. It is a fixed brick bridge in the Amsterdam School style.

name: Frederiksplein
en: The Frederiksplein is a square in Amsterdam-Centrum, named in 1870 after Prince Frederick, uncle of King William III. The square extends along Utrechtsestraat, between the Weteringschans and the Sarphatistraat. De Nederlandsche Bank is located on the square.

name: Frederiksstraat
en: The Frederiksstraat is a relatively short street in Amsterdam Oud-West.

name: Freek Oxstraat
en: Freek Oxstraat is a street in the Amsterdam garden city of Slotermeer. The street was named after resistance fighter Freek Ox on July 9, 1952.

name: Furkabaan
en: The Furkabaan is a street in the Lunetten subdistrict in the Dutch city of Utrecht. The Furkabaan, built in 1976, together with the "Stelviobaan", "Brennerbaan" and "Simplonbaan" forms the Lunetten bypass. The Furkabaan starts at Utrecht Lunetten Station and transitions into the "Simplonbaan" in the south of Lunetten.

name: Fusillade
en: Fusillade, also known as The Fallen Hornblower, is a bronze statue in the Eerste Weteringplantsoen in Amsterdam, made in 1954 by Gerrit Bolhuis. Here, the German army executed thirty political prisoners on March 12, 1945 as a reprisal for a resistance act.

name: Gaardbrug
en: The Gaardbrug is a nationally protected arched bridge in the city center of Utrecht. The bridge spans the Oudegracht. Around 1400, the Oudegracht could already be crossed at this location and the location belonged to the market area that used to be located in and around the trading district of Stathe.

name: Gaasp
en: Gaasp can refer to: Gaasp (river), a river in North Holland Gaasp, a former branch of the Lek south of Vianen

name: Gaasperpark
en: The Gaasperpark is a park in Gaasperdam, Amsterdam-Zuidoost district, on the northern bank of the Gaasperplas, an artificial recreation lake, created by sand mining for the elevation for the construction of Gaasperdam. The Gaasperpark is managed by Groengebied Amstelland and Recreatie Noord-Holland NV. It belongs to the Nature Network Nede

name: Gaasperzoom
en: The Gaasperzoom is a park and nature reserve in Amsterdam-Zuidoost. The area is located east of the Gein residential district, west of the Gein stream, north of the Ruwelswal and south of the Gaasperplas. The area was developed at the beginning of the 1980s, at the same time as the Gein district was ready. A bicycle path crosses it

name: Galecopperbrug
en: The Galecopperbrug is a steel tube bridge over the Amsterdam-Rhine Canal near the city of Utrecht. The bridge actually consists of two parts, the first part of which was opened in 1971 and the second part in 1976. The bridge serves as part of the A12 motorway and replaced a 1936 arch bridge. The old bridge was moved about 2 km northwest and

name: Galgenbrug
en: The Galgenbrug (bridge 315) is a permanent bridge in Amsterdam-Centrum. The bridge is located between Bickerseiland and Prinseneiland. It was built between 1625 (the map by Balthasar Florisz. van Berckenrode from 1625 does not show the bridge) and 1649 (the map by Joan Blaeu does show the bridge).

name: Galgenbrug
en: The Galgenbrug (bridge 315) is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-Centrum. It lies between Bickerseiland and Prinseneiland. It was built between 1625, as Balthasar Florisz. van Berckenrode's map of that year does not show it, and 1649, as Joan Blaeu's map does. Gerrit de Broen (II)'s map of 1737 shows an oorgat bridge here.

name: Galileïplantsoen
en: The Galileïplantsoen is a park with associated streets in Amsterdam-Oost.

name: Gedenksteen
en: The Gedenksteen for the former Detention Center, also known as Gedenksteen 4 May, is a work of art in Amsterdam-Centrum. The plastic was designed by architect Pieter Zaanen, he was responsible for the new building around 1990 on the Max Euweplein. The statue stands on a separate part of the square on the side of the Kleine-Gartmanplantsoen,

name: Gedenksteen
en: The Gedenksteen voor het voormalig Huis van Bewaring, also called the Gedenksteen 4 mei, is an artwork in Amsterdam-Centrum. The sculpture was designed by the architect Pieter Zaanen, who was responsible for the new building around 1990 on the Max Euweplein. It stands on a separate part of the square towards the Kleine-Gartmanplantsoen.

name: Geert Geertsenbrug
en: The Geert Geertsenbrug (bridge 395) is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-West. The pedestrian bridge is located on the western edge of Erasmus Park and provides access from Hondiusstraat and Mercatorstraat. It spans the ring moat surrounding the park. Near the entrance is the restaurant Terrasmus (location 2022) located in the park.

name: Geert Geertsenbrug
en: The Geert Geertsenbrug (bridge 395) is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-West. The footbridge lies on the western edge of the Erasmuspark and provides access from the Hondiusstraat and Mercatorstraat, spanning the ring ditch around the park. The bridge dates from around 1970.

name: Geertebrug
en: The Geertebrug is a nationally protected arched bridge in the city center of Utrecht. The bridge spans the Oudegracht.

name: Geertekerk
en: The Geertekerk is a church in the Dutch city of Utrecht. In the Middle Ages it was one of the four parish churches in that city, and the smallest and youngest, dedicated to the saint Gertrude of Nijvel. The first building was built on a site outside the walls, but between 1248 and 1259 the church was moved inside the city walls. Since then, n

name: Geertje Wielemaplein
en: The Geertje Wielemaplein is a square in Amsterdam-Oost. The square is located on the Zeeburgereiland, the front line of IJburg northeast of the intersection of Zuiderzeeweg and IJburglaan, both busy main routes in Amsterdam Oost. The square was named in 2016, after swimmer Geertje Wielema, after the earlier decision to name a street after

name: Gein
en: Gein is a residential area in Amsterdam-Zuidoost in the Gaasperdam district. The name of the area is derived from the Gein stream running east of the area. The first houses were completed in 1982 and the area was largely completed in the late 1980s.

name: Gemeenlandshuis
en: The Gemeenlandshuis of Diemen stands at Diemerzeedijk 27 in Amsterdam-Oost. As the name suggests it was originally a water board house. The building stands in the shadow of the Zeeburgerbrug.

name: George Madurobrug
en: The George Madurobrug (bridge 1036) is a structure in Amsterdam-Zuidoost, a combination of a bridge and a viaduct. It crosses a foot and cycle path in the Nelson Mandelapark and a drainage channel of that same park. It lies in the Karspeldreef, a through route in Amsterdam-Zuidoost that cuts the park in two.

name: George Madurobrug
en: The George Madurobrug (bridge 1036) is a structural work of art in Amsterdam-Zuidoost. The bridge is a combination of a bridge and viaduct. It crosses a foot and bicycle path in Nelson Mandelapark and a drainage ditch from the same park. The structure is located in Karspeldreef, a main route in Amsterdam-Zuidoost, which cuts through the park in half.

name: Ger van Zanenbrug
en: Ger van Zanenbrug (bridge 2372) is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam Nieuw-West, serving as the successor to bridge 700.

name: Gerard Dou Synagogue
en: The Gerard Doustraat Synagogue in the De Pijp district of Amsterdam was built in 1892 for the Ashkenazi congregation Tesjoe'at Israël. The architect E.M. Rood (1851-1929) chose a neo-Renaissance style. Among the houses in the street the synagogue at number 238 is barely noticeable, which may be why the Germans overlooked it.

name: Gerard Dou Synagogue
en: The Synagoge Gerard Doustraat in the Amsterdam district of de Pijp was built in 1892 at the behest of Ashkenazi chevre Tesjoe'at Israel (Hulpe Israëls). Architect E.M. Rood (1851–1929) chose a neo-Renaissance architectural style. Between the residential houses on the street, the synagogue Gerard Doustraat 238 hardly stands out.

name: Gerardus Majellakerk
en: The Gerardus Majellakerk is a Roman Catholic parish church in Utrecht. The church building was designed by the architect H.C. van de Leur and built around 1934. The building is valued as a municipal monument. The architecture of the church building is typical of the interwar period and is inspired by the formal style of Dom Paul Bellot.

name: Gerbrandypark
en: The Gerbrandypark is a city park in Amsterdam Nieuw-West. The park is located along the Burgemeester Van Tienhovengracht in Slotermeer between the Ringspoorbaan and the Plein '40-'45. The park was laid out between 1957 and 1965 and was named in 1963 after the Dutch politician and statesman Pieter Sjoerds Gerbrandy (1885-1961).

name: Gerda Tarobrug
en: The Gerda Tarobrug (bridge 2125) is a constructional work of art under construction in Amsterdam-Oost. From August 2021, work began on the construction of this bridge that is to connect Centrumeiland and Strandeiland in IJburg. The bridge will be located over the Merdekagracht. If construction begins, Centrumeiland has not yet been completed and Strandeiland

name: Gerda Tarobrug
en: The Gerda Tarobrug (bridge 2125) is a structure under construction in Amsterdam-Oost. Work began in August 2021 on this bridge, which is to connect Centrumeiland with Strandeiland in IJburg. It will cross the Merdekagracht.

name: Gerrie Mührenbrug
en: The Gerrie Mührenbrug (bridge 2235) is a structural work of art in Amsterdam-Oost. The bridge is one of the traffic bridges (the others are for slow traffic) that forms the connection within the Park de Meer neighborhood within the Watergraafsmeer, which rose from the ground here between 1998 and 2002.

name: Geuzenbos
en: The Geuzenbos is a nature reserve in the Groote IJpolder between the Spaarnwoude Recreation Area, the De Heining business park and the Spaarndammerdijk northeast of Halfweg in the Amsterdam district of Westpoort. The area with an area of 60 hectares is divided in two by the Essenweg alderman. One of the entrances to the Geuzenbos

name: Gierzwaluwbrug
en: Brug 1189, or Gierzwaluwbrug, is a structure in Amsterdam-Zuidoost. It lies in a footpath in the Bijlmerweide park and spans a ring of water around an island, in line with bridge 1187. The first bridge here dated from 1970: Dirk Sterenberg of the Dienst der Publieke Werken designed a wooden footbridge almost ten metres long.

name: Gierzwaluwbrug
en: Bridge 1189 or Gierzwaluwbrug is a building art work in Amsterdam-Zuidoost. The bridge is located in a footpath in the Bijlmerweide park and spans a ring water around an island. It is along the extension of bridge 1187. The first bridge built here dates back to 1970. Dirk Sterenberg of the Public Works Department designed a nearly ten meter long l

name: Gooiseweg
en: The Gooiseweg is part of the Amsterdam city route s112 and runs from Prins Bernhardplein near Amstel station to Gaasperdam. The road is built as a motorway with level crossings, but on the first section there is also a bicycle path on both sides.

name: Goudriaankanaal
en: The Goudriaankanaal is an unfinished canal through Waterland, between IJdoorn (Durgerdam) and the east coast of Marken. It was supposed to form a new connection between Amsterdam and the North Sea. Construction began in 1826 and was stopped in 1828.

name: Goudvinkbrug
en: Bridge 1187 or Goudvinkbrug is a structural work of art in Amsterdam-Zuidoost. The bridge is located on a footpath in the Bijlmerweide park and spans a ring lake around an island. The first bridge built here dates back to 1970. Dirk Sterenberg of the Public Works Department designed a nearly ten-meter-long wooden footbridge that did not have bridge pillars.

name: Goudvinkbrug
en: Brug 1187, or Goudvinkbrug, is a structure in Amsterdam-Zuidoost. It lies in a footpath in the Bijlmerweide park and spans a ring of water around an island. The first bridge here dated from 1970: Dirk Sterenberg of the Dienst der Publieke Werken designed a wooden footbridge almost ten metres long, built without piers.

name: Graadt van Roggenweg
en: The Graadt van Roggenweg is a street in the Dutch city of Utrecht. The street separates the Leidseweg and surrounding neighborhoods and the Dichterswijk, and is located near the Jaarbeurs.

name: Grenspaal
en: Grenspaal, also known as the Column-bearing Turtle or Monument of Jacob Israël de Haan is a statue in Amsterdam-Centrum. It was made by Hans 't Mannetje. The statue is located at the beginning of Jodenbreestraat, at the point where the road begins at Sint Anthoniesluis. The monument somewhat resembles a so-called banpole, once a marking point for city limits

name: Griftpark
en: The Griftpark is a park in the Dutch city of Utrecht, located in the Noordoost district on the streets Blauwkapelseweg and Kleine Singel. The stream the Biltsche Grift runs through the park, which is where the park gets its name.

name: Grimnessesluis
en: The Grimnessesluis (bridge 202) is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-Centrum. The short traffic bridge provides the connection between the east side of the street section of the Rokin and the Oude Turfmarkt. It spans the small waterway between the Grimburgwal and the same Rokin, but then open water.

name: Grimnessesluis
en: The Grimnessesluis (bridge 202) is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-Centrum. The short traffic bridge connects the eastern side of the street section of the Rokin with the Oude Turfmarkt, spanning the small waterway between the Grimburgwal and that same Rokin where it is open water. It is surrounded by national monuments.

name: Groene spechtbrug
en: Brug 1186, or Groene spechtbrug, is a structure in Amsterdam-Zuidoost. It lies in a footpath in the Bijlmerweide park and spans a ring of water around an island. The first bridge here dated from 1970: Dirk Sterenberg of the Dienst der Publieke Werken designed a wooden footbridge almost ten metres long, built without piers.

name: Groene spechtbrug
en: Bridge 1186 or Groene spechtbrug is a building art work in Amsterdam-Zuidoost. The bridge is located on a footpath in the Bijlmerweide park and spans a ring lake around an island. The first bridge built here dates back to 1970. Dirk Sterenberg of the Public Works Department designed a nearly ten-meter-long wooden footbridge that without a bridge

name: Groene Tunnel
en: The Groene Tunnel is a 35-meter-wide canal between Haveneiland and the Grote Rieteiland, and between the northern and southern part of Haveneiland-Oost, in the residential district IJburg in the Oost district of Amsterdam. The canal crosses the district from northwest to southeast.

name: Groentemarktbrug
en: The Groentemarktbrug (bridge 156) is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-Centrum. The traffic bridge is located in Marnixstraat. It spans a passage between on the one hand (on the center side) the Lauriergracht (with bridge 110 over it) and Lijnbaansgracht and on the other hand (west side) the Singelgracht.

name: Groentemarktbrug
en: The Groentemarktbrug (bridge 156) is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-Centrum. The traffic bridge lies in the Marnixstraat and spans the passage between the Lauriergracht and Lijnbaansgracht on the centre side and the Singelgracht to the west. Several municipal monuments stand north of the bridge.

name: Groentepraambrug
en: The Groentepraambrug (bridge 129) is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-West. The footbridge connects Van Kinsbergenstraat with Cabotstraat and spans the Admiralengracht. The bridge is located between the Molenslootbrug and the Machineslootbrug and was built because the distance between these two traffic bridges, about 700 meters, is quite large for pedestrians.

name: Groentepraambrug
en: The Groentepraambrug (bridge 129) is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-West. The footbridge connects the Van Kinsbergenstraat with the Cabotstraat, spanning the Admiralengracht. It lies between the Molenslootbrug and the Machineslootbrug, and was built because the roughly 700 metres between those two traffic bridges is a long way on foot.

name: Groote Museum
en: The Groote Museum is a museum on the Plantage Middenlaan in Amsterdam exploring the connections between people, animals, plants, microbes and the earth. It occupies the first floor of the former main building of Artis and is run by Artis, but can be visited independently of the zoo.

name: Gustav Leonhardtbrug
en: Gustav Leonhardtbrug (bridge 449) is a fixed bridge in the Beatrixpark in Amsterdam-Zuid. It is for pedestrians and cyclists only and leads to the Willem Landréstraat entrance in the Componistenbuurt. It dates from 1962, after the Willem Landréstraat was laid out and built up around 1954.

name: Gustav Leonhardtbrug
en: Gustav Leonhardtbrug (bridge 449 is a fixed bridge in Beatrixpark in Amsterdam-Zuid. The bridge is only suitable for pedestrians and cyclists, and leads to entrance/exit Willem Landréstraat in the composers' neighborhood.

name: Gwijde van Henegouwenbrug
en: The Gwijde van Henegouwenbrug (bridge 805) is a structure in Amsterdam-Zuid. It dates from 1960/1962, when the architect Dirk Sterenberg worked for the Dienst der Publieke Werken. He was allowed to design all the foot and cycle bridges in the Gijsbrecht van Aemstelpark and even to lay out the Ontmoetingseiland.

name: Gwijde van Henegouwenbrug
en: The Gwijde van Henegouwenbrug (bridge 805) is a Work of Art in Amsterdam-Zuid. The bridge dates back to 1960/1962 when architect Dirk Sterenberg worked for the Department of Public Works. He was allowed to design all the foot and bicycle bridges in the Gijsbrecht van Aemstelpark and even design the Meeting Island.

name: Haardsteebrug
en: The Haardsteebrug (bridge 1063) is a structure in Amsterdam-Zuidoost.

name: Haarlemmermeerstraat
en: The Haarlemmermeerstraat is a street in Amsterdam-Zuid. The street connects the Hoofddorpplein with the Surinameplein and was named in 1927 after the Haarlemmermeer. Other streets in the neighborhood are also named after places southwest of Amsterdam. The street is about 650 meters long. Halfway between Theophile de Bockstraat and the Albert Neuhuyss

name: Haarlemmerpoort
en: The Haarlemmerpoort on the Haarlemmerplein in Amsterdam is officially called Willemspoort but is never called that in the city. It is in fact the fifth gate on the side of Haarlem that appears in the history of Amsterdam. The earlier gates were part of the fortifications of Amsterdam. With each city expansion, the city gate moved a little further forward

name: Haarlemmerpoort
en: The Haarlemmerpoort on the Haarlemmerplein in Amsterdam is officially called the Willemspoort, but is never called that in the city. It is in fact the fifth gate on the Haarlem side in Amsterdam's history. The earlier gates were part of the city's fortifications, and with each expansion the gate moved a little further out.

name: Haarlemmersluis
en: The Haarlemmersluis is a 17th-century lock in the centre of Amsterdam. It lies at the eastern end of the Brouwersgracht, where the Singel flows into the IJ. The fixed bridge at the lock, bridge number 14, connects the Nieuwendijk and the Haarlemmerstraat. The lock is a popular tourist spot, with large numbers of canal boats passing through.

name: Haarlemmersluis
en: The Haarlemmersluis is a 17th-century lock in the center of Amsterdam. The lock is located at the eastern end of the Brouwersgracht, on the site where the Singel flows into the IJ. The fixed bridge (bridge number 14) near the lock connects the Nieuwendijk and Haarlemmerstraat. The lock is a popular tourist attraction.

name: Haarlemmervaart
en: The Haarlemmertrekvaart is a canal built in 1631 between Amsterdam and Haarlem.

name: Haarlemmerweg
en: The Haarlemmerweg is a road in the municipality of Amsterdam, towards Haarlem. The road runs from the Nassaukade to Halfweg. The Haarlemmerweg is the longest street in Amsterdam and has a length of 8.3 kilometers.

name: Halvemaansbrug
en: The Halvemaansbrug (bridge 221) is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-Centrum. It connects the two quays of the Amstel, called the Binnen Amstel here, in the inner city. On the north side lie a quay of the Kloveniersburgwal and 's-Gravelandseveer; on the south side the Amstel's quay is simply named after the river.

name: Halvemaansbrug
en: The Halvemaansbrug (bridge 221) is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-Centrum. It forms the connection between the two embankments of the Amstel (here called Binnen Amstel) in the city center of Amsterdam. On the north side there is still another embankment of the Kloveniersburgwal and 's-Gravelandseveer (embankment of the Amstel).

name: Hamburgerbrug
en: The Hamburgerbrug is a nationally protected arched bridge in the city center of the Dutch city of Utrecht. The bridge spans the Oudegracht. The Hamburgerbrug is named in a modified form after the former medieval city castle Rodenburg that stood on the northeast side of the bridge. In earlier times, the bridge was also called the Romanburg Bridge there.

name: Han Lammersbrug
en: The Han Lammersbrug (bridge no. 2202) is a pedestrian and cyclist bridge over the Westerdok in Amsterdam. The bridge connects the Westerdokskade with the Westerdokseiland, a former railway yard of NS that was redeveloped in the early 21st century as a residential area.

name: Han Lammersbrug
en: The Han Lammersbrug (bridge no. 2202) is a bridge for pedestrians and cyclists over the Westerdok in Amsterdam. It connects the Westerdokskade with Westerdokseiland, a former NS marshalling yard redeveloped as a residential district in the early 21st century. It is named after Han Lammers (1931-2000), a former Amsterdam alderman.

name: Han van Zomerenbrug
en: The Han van Zomerenbrug (bridge 402) is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-Zuid. The wooden bridge that is only accessible to pedestrians (a traffic sign indicates that cyclists should disembark!) has been the connection between Pieter Lodewijk Takstraat and Waalstraat since 2009.

name: Han van Zomerenbrug
en: The Han van Zomerenbrug (bridge 402) is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-Zuid. The wooden bridge, open to pedestrians only — a sign tells cyclists to dismount — has connected the Pieter Lodewijk Takstraat with the Waalstraat since 2009. It spans the Amstelkanaal and also links the Jozef Israëlskade with the Amstelkade.

name: Hannie Schaftbrug
en: The Hannie Schaftbrug (bridge no. 601) is a structure in the Slotermeer district of Amsterdam Nieuw-West.

name: Hanny Michaelisbrug
en: The Hanny Michaelisbrug (bridge 405) is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-Zuid. It is one of the four bridges that enclose De Kom in the road network. It crosses the Noorder Amstelkanaal, whose south bank is called the Mozartkade, connecting the Stadionweg with the Hobbemakade. It was built around 1927 to a design by Piet Kramer.

name: Hanny Michaelisbrug
en: The Hanny Michaelisbrug (bridge 405) is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-Zuid. The bridge is one of the four bridges that enclose the De Kom road network. The bridge crosses the Noorder Amstel Canal, whose south bank is called Mozartkade. It connects Stadionweg with Hobbemakade.

name: Hans Kressebrug
en: Bridge 716 is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam Nieuw-West. The pedestrian and bicycle bridge spans the Christoffel Plantijngracht, which runs parallel to the Christoffel Plantijnpad. It is located at the height of the Johan Brakensiekhof and the Theo Mann-Bouwmeesterhof.

name: Hans Kressebrug
en: Brug 716 is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam Nieuw-West. The foot and cycle bridge spans the Christoffel Plantijngracht, which runs parallel to the Christoffel Plantijnpad, at the Johan Brakensiekhof and the Theo Mann-Bouwmeesterhof. Dick Slebos of the Publieke Werken designed a number of structures for the Christoffel Plantijnpad.

name: Hans Snoekfontein
en: The Hans Snoekfontein is a work of art in Amsterdam-Centrum. The fountain is named after Hans Snoek, founder of the Scapino Ballet, who financially contributed to the construction of the fountain and the renovation of the square through a legacy. Other contributions came from American Hotel and Holland Casino.

name: Haparandadam
en: The Haparandadam is a dam in Amsterdam-West. The dam forms the border between the Houthaven district and the Western Port Area. The dam is named after the Swedish port city of Haparanda on the Gulf of Bothnia, on the border with Finland, where much wood came from to Amsterdam.

name: Haringpakkersbrug
en: The Haringpakkersbrug (bridge 58) is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-Centrum. It is named after the Haring Pakkerye, the herring packers' works once located here. The name also survived in the Haringpakkerstoren, demolished in 1829 and standing north-west of the bridge's present position, and in the Haringpakkerssteeg.

name: Hartmanbrug
en: The Hartmanbrug (bridge no. 190) is a slab bridge in Amsterdam-Oost. It lies in the Molukkenstraat and spans the Ringvaart, connecting the Indische Buurt with the Watergraafsmeer. The quay along the Ringvaart is called the Valentijnkade on the north side and the Ooster Ringdijk on the south.

name: Hartmanbrug
en: The Hartmanbrug (bridge no. 190) is a plate bridge in Amsterdam-Oost. It is located in the Molukkenstraat and spans the Ringvaart. The bridge thus connects the Indische Buurt with the Watergraafsmeer. The quay along the Ringvaart is called Valentijnkade on the north side and Ooster Ringdijk on the south side.

name: Havenstraat
en: The Havenstraat is a street in the Schinkel neighborhood, Amsterdam-Zuid.

name: Heemtuin Sloterpark
en: The Heemtuin Sloterpark is located in the Sloterpark west of the Sloterplas in Amsterdam Nieuw-West. After the land was raised in the 1950s, this area remained untouched for a long time. Here a rough area spontaneously developed with wild plants, reeds and willows.

name: Heibrug
en: The Heibrug (bridge no. 4) is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-Centrum. It spans the Singel and connects the Heisteeg, towards the centre, with the Wijde Heisteeg to the west. It became necessary after the city expansion of the late 16th century, when the west bank of the Singel was built up. It is drawn on Pieter Bast's city map.

name: Heibrug
en: The Heibrug (bridge no. 4) is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-Centrum. The bridge spans the Singel and forms the connection between the Heisteeg (towards the center) and Wijde Heisteeg (towards the west). The bridge became necessary after the city expansion at the end of the 16th century, during which the western bank of the Singel was also built up.

name: Heilige Nikolaas van Myrakerk
en: The Tichelkerk, or Tichel, is a church on the corner of the Lijnbaansgracht and the Tichelstraat in the Amsterdam Jordaan. It was built in 1912 as the Roman Catholic Sint-Antoniuskerk. In 2005 it became the Russian Orthodox Church of St Nicholas of Myra, and in the same year it was designated a municipal monument.

name: Heilige Nikolaas van Myrakerk
en: The Tichelkerk or Tichel is a church building at the corner of the Lijnbaansgracht and the Tichelstraat in the Amsterdamse Jordaan. It was built in 1912 as a Roman Catholic Sint-Antoniuskerk. In 2005 it became the Russian Orthodox Heilige Nikolaas van Myrakerk. In the same year the building was designated as a municipal monument. In response to the Russian

name: Heiligewegsluis
en: The Heiligewegsluis is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-Centrum. The bridge provides the connection between the western quay of the Singel and the Heiligeweg.

name: Hein Donnerbrug
en: The Hein Donnerbrug (bridge number 1922) is a structural work of art on the border of Amsterdam-Centrum and Amsterdam-Zuid. The bridge was named after Jan Hein Donner in his capacity as a chess player in 1991. The permanent concrete bridge has spanned the Singelgracht since around 1988.

name: Hein Donnerbrug
en: The Hein Donnerbrug (bridge number 1922) is a structure on the boundary of Amsterdam-Centrum and Amsterdam-Zuid. It was named in 1991 after Jan Hein Donner in his capacity as a chess player. The fixed concrete bridge has spanned the Singelgracht since around 1988, connecting the Max Euweplein, named after the chess player Max Euwe, with the Weteringschans.

name: Hendrick Jacobsz Staetsbrug
en: The Hendrick Jacobsz. Staetsbrug (bridge 35) is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-Centrum. It lies in the west bank of the Amstel and spans the Herengracht, which ends here. The canal does continue on the far side, but under the name Nieuwe Herengracht, beginning at the Walter Süskindbrug.

name: Hendrick Jacobsz Staetsbrug
en: The Hendrick Jacobsz. Staetsbrug (bridge 35) is a permanent bridge in Amsterdam-Centrum. The bridge is located on the western bank of the Amstel and spans the Herengracht, which ends here. On the other side, the canal continues, but under the name Nieuwe Herengracht, starting at the Walter Süskind Bridge. There has been a building here for centuries. On the

name: Henk Sneevlietweg
en: The Henk Sneevlietweg is a street with a median that is part of the main city route S107 in the subdistricts Overtoomse Veld and Slotervaart in Amsterdam Nieuw-West. The street was opened on April 2, 1975 and begins at Aalsmeerplein as a road and runs westwards where Anthony Fokkerstraat ground floor is crossed and the Naaldwijk

name: Hennetjesbrug
en: The Hennetjesbrug (bridge 179) is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam Oud-West. The bridge is located in Nicolaas Beetsstraat and spans the Jacob van Lennepkanaal. Southeast of the bridge was the former site of the Wilhelmina Gasthuis. Here, in May 1889, a traffic collection bridge was opened from the boiler of Bastiaan de Greef, city architect at the Diens

name: Henrietta Leavittbrug
en: The Henrietta Leavittbrug is a fixed bridge in Watergraafsmeer, Amsterdam. Formerly the anonymous bridge number 195, it spans the Ringvaart of the Watergraafsmeer at the dividing line between the Tie-Breakers tennis park and the Flevopark, on the west banks of the Nieuwe Diep. The Valentijnkade lies north of the ring canal.

name: Henrietta Leavittbrug
en: The Henrietta Leavittbrug is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam, Watergraafsmeer. The bridge, formerly known as the anonymous bridge number 195, spans the Ringvaart of the Watergraafsmeer near the halfway point of the Tie-Breakers tennis park and the Flevopark, located on the western banks of the Nieuwe Diep. North of the ringvaart lies the Valentijnkade, t

name: Henriette Schwarzpark
en: The Henriette Schwarzpark is a small park in Osdorp, Amsterdam-Nieuw West. It is located between the Baden Powellweg, Ookmeerweg and Osdorper Ban. It is crossed by a foot and bicycle path section of the Osdorperweg. The park of 311 (north-south) at 78 meters (east-west) was laid out on an already existing green strip and was renovated on September 1, 2022.

name: Henriëtte van Heukelom-van den Brandelerbrug
en: Henriëtte van Heukelom-van den Brandelerbrug is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-Zuid. It leads to the entrance of the Beatrixpark from the Prinses Irenestraat and crosses an edge watercourse of that park. It was designed in 1969 by the architect Dirk Sterenberg, working for the Dienst der Publieke Werken.

name: Henriëtte van Heukelom-van den Brandelerbrug
en: Henriëtte van Heukelom-van den Brandelerbrug is a permanent bridge in Amsterdam-Zuid. The bridge leads to the entrance and exit of Beatrixpark from/to Prinses Irenestraat. The bridge is located over a stream/draining ditch of the aforementioned park. It was designed in 1969 by architect Dirk Sterenberg working for and for the Public Works Service.

name: Herdenkingsmonument
en: Herdenkingsmonument, also known as Commemoration and remembrance, is an artistic work of art in the Gijsbrecht van Amstelpark, Buitenveldert, Amsterdam-Zuid. The image of artist Mischa Rakier (born Delft 1970) was placed in 2014 after an order from the municipality of Amsterdam and the South District.

name: Herdenkingsmonument
en: Herdenkingsmonument, also called Herdenken en herinnering, is an artistic work in the Gijsbrecht van Amstelpark in Buitenveldert, Amsterdam-Zuid. The sculpture by the artist Mischa Rakier, born in Delft in 1970, was placed in 2014 on a commission from the city of Amsterdam and the Zuid borough.

name: Herenbrug
en: The Herenbrug is a national monument bridge in the Dutch city of Utrecht. This fixed bridge is located on the east side of the Utrecht city center. It spans the Stadsbuitengracht there and connects to the Maliesingel at the level of the Lepelenburg park. The 1905 building has an arched span in reinforced concrete and is one of the first

name: Herepoort
en: The Herepoort was originally one of the city gates of the city of Groningen. The first Herepoort was probably built in the 11th century, the second in the 13th century, the third in the 15th century and the fourth at the beginning of the 17th century. Since 1885, the 17th-century outer gate has been in the garden of the Rijksmuseum in Amsterdam.

name: Herepoort
en: The Herepoort was originally one of the city gates of Groningen. The first Herepoort was probably built in the 11th century, the second in the 13th, the third in the 15th and the fourth in the early 17th century. Since 1885 the 17th-century outer gate has stood in the garden of the Rijksmuseum in Amsterdam.

name: Hertogswetering
en: The Hertogswetering is a watercourse in the northeast of the Dutch province of North Brabant.

name: Het Nieuwe Verbond
en: The Onze-Lieve-Vrouw-van-Lourdeskerk, now the Kerk van Het Nieuwe Verbond, is a Roman Catholic church in the garden city of Slotermeer in Amsterdam Nieuw-West. It was built in the middle of an almost empty site near the corner of the Burgemeester Röellstraat and the Slotermeerlaan, among a number of temporary Catholic schools.

name: Het Nieuwe Verbond
en: The Onze-Lieve-Vrouw-van-Lourdes church, today the Church of Het Nieuwe Verbond, is a Roman Catholic church in the garden city Slotermeer in Amsterdam Nieuw-West. The church was built in the middle of a nearly vacant area near the corner of Burgemeester Röellstraat and Slotermeerlaan, in the middle of a number of (Catholic) emergency schools.

name: Het Slochter
en: Het Slochter is part of the North Holland Canal in North Holland.

name: Het Veem Theater
en: Veem House for Performance, called Het Veem Theater until 2014, is a production house, workshop, stage, laboratory and centre of expertise for contemporary mime theatre, based in the Het Veem building in Amsterdam. The building stands on the Van Diemenstraat and the Oude Houthaven along the IJ, west of Centraal Station.

name: Hobbemakade
en: The Hobbemakade is a street in Amsterdam-Zuid. It is the western quay of the Boerenwetering between Singelgracht and De Kom. The quay on the other side is called the Ruysdaelkade and is located in the De Pijp district.

name: Hoeckelingsdam
en: The Hoeckelingsdam is a low, 1.6 kilometer long dam in the IJmeer, intended to create calm water between the dam and the Uitdammerdijk and thereby increase the natural value of the area. The dam is outside the dikes of the Kinselmeer and near the Kinsel pond, so it is also called Kinseldam. The southern end is near the Vuurt

name: Hoekenesgracht
en: Hoekenes in a street in Amsterdam Nieuw-West. The street is located in several neighborhoods (including Wildemanbuurt) in Osdorp due to its length.

name: Hofkerk
en: The Parish Church of the Holy Martyrs of Gorkum is a Roman Catholic church in Amsterdam-Watergraafsmeer. As the Hofkerk it forms part of the Linnaeushof complex designed by the architect Alexander Kropholler.

name: Hoge Sluis
en: The Hogesluis (bridge no. 246) is an Amsterdam monumental double bascule bridge with ten passages, designed by Willem Springer in Parisian style. The older bridge from the 17th century was replaced by the current one in 1883.

name: Hoge Sluis
en: The Hogesluis (bridge no. 246) is a monumental Amsterdam double bascule bridge with ten openings, designed by Willem Springer in a Parisian style. The older 17th-century bridge was replaced by the present one in 1883. The slab bridge, partly a bascule bridge, is decorated with cast-iron ornaments bearing city arms, a stone vase balustrade and obelisks.

name: Hogeweidebrug
en: The Hogeweidebrug is a steel arch bridge from 2008 over the Amsterdam-Rhine Canal. It connects the city of Utrecht with the district of Leidsche Rijn. It is a design by architect Maarten Struijs, the client was the 'Urban Development' department of the municipality of Utrecht.

name: Holendrecht
en: Holendrecht is a residential area (neighborhood) in Gaasperdam in the Amsterdam district Amsterdam-Zuidoost. The neighborhood takes its name from the river of the same name on the border of the provinces of North Holland and Utrecht.

name: Hollandse Tuin
en: The Hollandse Tuin is a 19th-century monumental garden within the Amsterdam zoo Artis. In the garden stands a monument by sculptor Bart van Hove.

name: Holy Trinity Church
en: The Holy Trinity Church is an Anglican parish church in the Utrecht district of Oudwijk at the Van Limburg Stirumplein near the Van Limburg Stirumstraat, dedicated to the Holy Trinity. The first stone was laid on November 9, 1911 by the Anglican bishop for Northern Europe Herbert Bury. A year later, the first church service was held and eventually w

name: Holysloter Die
en: The Holysloter Die is a creek, called "Die", located mostly in the municipality of Amsterdam and a small one in the municipality of Waterland. It is located north of the village of Holysloot, which belongs to the municipality of Amsterdam, and south of Broek in Waterland.

name: Hoofddorpweg
en: The Hoofddorpweg in the Hoofddorpplein neighborhood of Amsterdam-Zuid was built in the 1920s on the territory of the municipality of Sloten, which was annexed by Amsterdam in 1921.

name: Horst Blankenburgbrug
en: The Horst Blankenburgbrug (bridge 2293) is a structural work of art in Amsterdam. The bridge is one of the few traffic bridges (most are only for slow traffic) that forms the connection between Watergraafsmeer and the Park de Meer neighborhood, which was built here between 1998 and 2002.

name: Horst Blankenburgbrug
en: The Horst Blankenburgbrug (bridge 2293) is a structure in Amsterdam. It is one of the few traffic bridges — most are for slow traffic only — connecting the Watergraafsmeer with the Park de Meer neighbourhood, which was built here between 1998 and 2002. That neighbourhood is entirely surrounded by a ring ditch.

name: Hortusbrug
en: The Hortusbrug (bridge no. 239) is a bascule bridge in Amsterdam-Centrum. It spans the Nieuwe Herengracht, connecting the Muiderstraat with the Plantage Middenlaan. The concrete bridge from 1960 was designed by Dirk Sterenberg and has two openings, a fixed span and the bascule, with rounded piers between them faced in basalt blocks.

name: Hortusbrug
en: The Hortusbrug (bridge no. 239) is a bascule bridge in Amsterdam-Centrum. The bridge spans the Nieuwe Herengracht and thus connects the Muiderstraat with the Plantage Middenlaan.

name: Hortusplantsoen
en: The Hortusplantsoen is a park and street in the center of Amsterdam. The park is located on the south side of the Hortus Botanicus, between the Nieuwe Herengracht (corner Weesperstraat) and the Nieuwe Keizersgracht (near the bend where the canal transitions into the Plantage Muidergracht).

name: Houten Huis
en: Het Houten Huys is a building dating from 1528 or shortly thereafter on the Begijnhof in Amsterdam. It is one of the oldest houses in Amsterdam and, along with a building at the beginning of the Zeedijk, one of the two remaining houses with a wooden facade in Amsterdam.

name: Houten Huis
en: Het Houten Huys is a building on the Begijnhof in Amsterdam dating from 1528 or shortly after. It is one of the oldest houses in Amsterdam and, along with a building at the start of the Zeedijk, one of the two surviving houses with a wooden front. From the city's founding almost all Amsterdam houses were built of wood.

name: Houtensepad
en: The Houtensepad is a street in the Dutch city of Utrecht in the Bokkenbuurt. The approximately 320-meter-long street runs from the Laan van Kovelswade to the Schaapstraat, Lamstraat and the railway.

name: Houthavenpark
en: The Houthavenpark is a park in Amsterdam-West, located between the Spaarndammerbuurt and the Houthavens district. The southern boundary of the park is formed by the Spaarndammerdijk and Tasmanstraat, the northern border is the Stavangerweg. The park is partly located on the Spaarndammertunnel, which was opened in 2018.

name: Houtmankade
en: The Houtmankade is the designation of two Amsterdam canals. The canals are located on the western and eastern shores of the Westerkanaal with the side canals being the Le Mairegracht, the Van Noordtgracht and the Zoutkeetsgracht. The western canal is located in the Spaarndammer neighborhood, the eastern one is located in the Zeehelden neighborhood.

name: Houtzaagmolen De Ster
en: Houtzaagmolen de Ster is the center of Molenerf de Ster, one of the few almost completely preserved sawmill complexes in the Netherlands. Molenerf de Ster consists of the octagonal (wind) mill with sawmill, the miller's house, two servant's houses and three wood drying sheds. The top of the mill reaches 20 meters. The sails stand there

name: Hugo de Grootgracht
en: The Hugo de Grootgracht is a canal in Amsterdam-West.

name: Hugo de Vriesbrug
en: The Hugo de Vriesbrug (bridge 457) is a structure in Amsterdam-Oost. Although numbered as a bridge, it is a viaduct or a tunnel depending on the point of view. It spans the Hugo de Vrieslaan and lies in the Gooiseweg. The wish for a road between Amsterdam and Het Gooi dates back to the 1930s.

name: Hugo de Vriesbrug
en: The Hugo de Vriesbrug (bridge 457) is a work of art in Amsterdam-Oost. Although numbered as a bridge, it is a viaduct or tunnel depending on the point of view. The structure spans the Hugo de Vrieslaan and is located in the Gooiseweg.

name: Hugo de Vrieslaan
en: The Hugo de Vrieslaan is a street in the Watergraafsmeer neighborhood Jerusalem in Amsterdam-Oost. The street forms a busy traffic artery. The street is named after Hugo de Vries, a Dutch biologist, botanist and geneticist (1848-1935).

name: Hugo Wstinc
en: Hugo Wstinc (? - 1349) was a Dutch jurist. Mr. Wstinc (pronounce as Uustinc) was born into a prominent Utrecht family. After his studies, he joined the service of the prior of the Utrecht Dominican friars, Gijsbert van Bronchorst, and from 1329 of the official of the Utrecht bishop. After that, he is mentioned as a notary in Utrecht and rector va

name: Huis Bartolotti
en: Het Huis Bartolotti (also Het Bonte Huis) is a canal house at Herengracht 170-172 in Amsterdam. It was built around 1617 for Willem van den Heuvel tot Beichlingen, one of the richest Amsterdamers of that time, who had inherited a lot of money from a childless married uncle, Giovanni Battista Bartolotti, a merchant from Bologna. In the will of this uncle

name: Huis Bartolotti
en: Huis Bartolotti, also called Het Bonte Huis, is a canal house at Herengracht 170-172 in Amsterdam. It was built around 1617 for Willem van den Heuvel tot Beichlingen, one of the richest Amsterdammers of his day, who had inherited a great deal of money from a childless uncle by marriage, the Bologna merchant Giovanni Battista Bartolotti.

name: Huis van de wijk Lydia
en: Huize Lydia or Buurthuis Lydia is a multifunctional center located at the corner of Roelof Hartplein, Joh. M. Coenenstraat and Bronckhorststraat in Amsterdam. It was originally a girls' home (pension for single people), where unmarried women lived, but also unmarried men. Also many nurses who in the Onze Lieve Vrouwe Gasthuis we

name: Huiszittenbrug
en: Bridge 8 is the official designation of a bridge in Amsterdam-Centrum. The bridge had the unofficial name Huiszittenbrug until July 5, 2016, which referred to the Huiszitten warehouse. However, this name has become obsolete. The fixed plate bridge is located in the Raadhuisstraat and spans the Singel.

name: Huiszittenbrug
en: Brug 8 is the official name of a bridge in Amsterdam-Centrum. Until 5 July 2016 it carried the unofficial name Huiszittenbrug, referring to the Huiszittenpakhuis, but that name has since lapsed. The fixed slab bridge lies in the Raadhuisstraat and spans the Singel. A bridge had stood here for at least two centuries.

name: Huntumbrug
en: The Huntumbrug (bridge 1041) is a structural work of art in Amsterdam-Zuidoost. The viaduct was built in the Karspeldreef, an important traffic route for fast traffic that runs from east to west through the district. It spans the Bijlmerpleinpad, a foot and bicycle path that winds from north to south through the district.

name: Huntumbrug
en: The Huntumbrug (bridge 1041) is a structure in Amsterdam-Zuidoost. The viaduct was built in the Karspeldreef, a major route for fast traffic running east to west through the borough. It spans the Bijlmerpleinpad, a foot and cycle path winding north to south through the borough.

name: HvA
en: The University of Applied Sciences for Economic Studies (HES) in Amsterdam was an HBO educational institution with programs in the field of economics and was a school with a tradition of more than 125 years. Today, it has become part of the economic education institute of the University of Amsterdam.

name: IJ-toren
en: IJ-toren may refer to the IJ-toren on the Veemkade, a 1998 residential tower in Amsterdam, or the IJ-toren on the Piet Heinkade, an office tower from 2002 in Amsterdam.

name: IJdoornlaan
en: The IJdoornlaan is an important east-west through route in Amsterdam-North. The street connects the Zuiderzeeweg in Nieuwendam-North, with Buikslotermeer, Banne Buiksloot and Landsmeer and runs under the A10 through to the Zuideinde in Landsmeer. The street is the northernmost through road in Amsterdam.

name: IJhaven
en: The Eastern Harbor Area is a residential district in the Dutch city of Amsterdam. It is also one of the fifteen districts within the Amsterdam-Oost district.

name: IJsbaanpad
en: The IJsbaanpad is a street in Amsterdam-Zuid, between the Amstelveenseweg and the Schinkel. The Amsterdamsche IJsclub (AIJC) had a field near the Schinkel in use, which was submerged in winter to create an ice surface. The road to it was therefore named IJsbaanpad in 1949. On the former ice club grounds are now tennis courts.

name: IJsselwetering
en: The IJsselwetering is a drainage channel in the municipalities of Utrecht and IJsselstein, which belong to the Dutch province of Utrecht. Its beginning coincides with the starting point of the Lange Vliet, about 3 km south of De Meern. The Lange Vliet runs north from this point and the IJsselwetering to the southeast, approximately parallel to the Holl

name: Ikeda Friendship and Peace Center
en: The Sint-Lucaskerk is the former church building of the Roman Catholic Sint-Lucas parish in Amsterdam-Osdorp. When the garden city Osdorp was built from 1958, a Roman Catholic church was also provided for. Pastor H.J. Heesterbeek was appointed building pastor on April 7, 1959 and on August 29 of the same year a temporary church was blessed at the Mee

name: Ikeda Friendship and Peace Center
en: The Sint-Lucaskerk is the former church of the Roman Catholic St Luke's parish in Amsterdam-Osdorp. When the garden city of Osdorp went up from 1958, a Roman Catholic church was provided for as well. H.J. Heesterbeek was appointed building priest on 7 April 1959, and a temporary church was consecrated that August.

name: Ina Boekbinderbrug
en: Ina Boekbinderbrug (bridge 416) is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-Zuid. It lies in the Minervalaan and spans the Zuider Amstelkanaal. Hendrik Petrus Berlage already drew this bridge on his plan for Plan Zuid of 1915; even then it was rather narrow compared with the width of the Minervalaan.

name: Ina Boekbinderbrug
en: Ina Boekbinderbrug (bridge 416) is a permanent bridge in Amsterdam-Zuid. The bridge is located in the Minervalaan and spans the Zuider Amstel Canal. Hendrik Petrus Berlage already drew this bridge on his plan for Plan Zuid from 1915. The width of the bridge was already quite narrow compared to the width of the Minervalaan.

name: Ina Boudier Bakkerbrug
en: The Ina Boudier-Bakkerbrug (bridge 609) is a permanent bridge in the Slotermeer district of Amsterdam. The bridge is located in Burgemeester Fockstraat and spans the Burgemeester van Tienhovengracht. The bridge was built to open up Slotermeer-Noord. The bridge has its landheads in Gerbrandypark and the southern quay of the aforementioned canal.

name: Ina Boudier Bakkerbrug
en: The Ina Boudier-Bakkerbrug (bridge 609) is a fixed bridge in the Slotermeer district of Amsterdam. It lies in the Burgemeester Fockstraat and spans the Burgemeester van Tienhovengracht. It was built to open up Slotermeer-Noord, with its abutments in the Gerbrandypark and the south quay of that canal, and dates from 1953/1954.

name: Industriehavenbrug
en: The Industriehavenbrug is a steel traffic bridge in the Dutch city of Utrecht. The bridge has a passage width of 14 meters and a road surface of 8 meters wide. It was built in 1920 and renovated in 1997. It is a municipal monument. The movable bridge is located on the Keulsekade over the connection of the Industrial Port with the Amsterdam-Rhine Canal.

name: Insulindeweg
en: The Insulindeweg in Amsterdam-Oost was named in 1923 and was named after the Insulinde, the name that Multatuli had given to the then Dutch East Indies, derived from the Latin 'insula' = island. The name refers to the term used by Multatuli in Max Havelaar for East Indies: Insulinde. The islands of this Insulinde are the

name: Isa van Eeghenbrug
en: The Isa van Eeghenbrug is a fixed slab bridge with three openings in Amsterdam-Centrum.

name: Isaac Israëlsbrug
en: The Isaac Israëlsbrug (bridge 408), also known as the Schildersbrug, is a bridge in Amsterdam-Zuid. It spans the Noorder Amstelkanaal, connecting the Cornelis Schuytstraat with the Breitnerstraat. The present bridge was built in 1961 and was, at least on the drawing board, the third here, the first having been called the Academiebrug.

name: Isaac Israëlsbrug
en: The Isaac Israëlsbrug, (Bridge 408), also known as Schildersbrug, is a bridge in Amsterdam-Zuid. The bridge spans the Noorder Amstel Canal and forms the connection between the Cornelis Schuytstraat and the Breitnerstraat.

name: J.M. de Muinck Keizerbrug
en: The J.M. de Muinck Keizerbrug in the Dutch city of Utrecht is named after the namesake of the Demka steelworks. It is a flyover bridge with four lanes that spans the Vecht River. It connects the J.M. de Muinck Keizerlaan with the Franciscusdreef. It was built around 1970 and forms the second direct connection between the Zuilen and Overvecht subdistricts.

name: Jaargetijden
en: Brug Driemond is a lift bridge over the Weespertrekvaart in the North Holland village of Driemond. Until 1966, the bridge and village were in the municipality of Weesperkarspel.

name: Jac. P. Thijsseplein
en: Jac.P. Thijsseplein is a square in Volewijck, Amsterdam-North.

name: Jacob de Vries
en: The list of Stolpersteine in Utrecht (municipality) gives an overview of the commemorative stones that have been placed in the municipality of Utrecht in the Dutch province of Utrecht as part of the Stolpersteine project of the German sculptor-artist Gunter Demnig. Stolpersteine are dedicated to victims of Nazism, all those who were murdered by it.

name: Jacoba van Tongerenbrug
en: The Jacoba van Tongerenbrug (bridge number 602) is a fixed bridge in Slotermeer, Amsterdam Nieuw-West. The traffic bridge lies in the Burgemeester Fockstraat and crosses the Afwateringstocht, leading to the Gerbrandypark to the south. It was built in 1953 to a 1950 design by Piet Kramer, though the year stones read 1951.

name: Jacoba van Tongerenbrug
en: The Jacoba van Tongerenbrug (bridge number 602) is a permanent bridge in Amsterdam Nieuw-West, Slotermeer. The traffic bridge is located in Burgemeester Fockstraat and spans the Afwateringstocht. It leads to the southern Gerbrandypark. The bridge was built in 1953 according to a design by Piet Kramer from 1950 (the date stones mention 1951). The bridge is

name: Jacobibrug
en: The Jacobibrug is a nationally protected arched bridge in the Utrecht city center that spans the Oudegracht. The bridge has two spans and in the bridge abutments are bridge cellars. Adjacent to the Jacobibrug are workshop cellars and yards. Around 1300, people could already cross the Oudegracht here. The nearby Jacobikerk was built a little earlier.

name: James Rosskade
en: The James Rosskade is a street in the Bos en Lommer district in the Amsterdam municipality of West. The street runs south-north in terms of numbering and begins as such at the ventweg on the north side of the Jan van Galenstraat and ends on the southern quay of the Erasmusgracht. It runs parallel to the Einsteinweg.

name: Jan Evertsenbrug
en: The Jan Evertsenbrug (145p) is a work of art in Amsterdam Nieuw-West. Although the name is associated with a bridge, it is a system of viaducts and bridges, Amsterdam usually refers to viaducts as bridges. The viaduct and bridge system, entirely made of concrete, is located in the Ringweg Amsterdam and spans the Jan Evertsen and a parallel waterway.

name: Jan Evertsenbrug
en: The Jan Evertsenbrug (145p) is a structure in Amsterdam Nieuw-West. Although it bears the name of a bridge it is a system of viaducts and bridges; Amsterdam usually calls viaducts bridges. The all-concrete system lies in the Ringweg Amsterdam and spans the Jan Evertsenstraat and a waterway running parallel to it.

name: Jan Pieterszoon Coenbrug
en: The Jan Pieterszoon Coenbrug is a double lift bridge in the Dutch city of Utrecht. The bridge, named after Jan Pieterszoon Coen, was built in 1897 by the contractor W. van Straten from Utrecht. The upper structure comes from the Utrechtsche Grofsmederij Fa P.H. Hörmann. It spans the Leidse Rijn at the level of J.P. Coenstraat. In a newspaper report in the

name: Jan Schaeferbrug
en: The Jan Schaeferbrug (bridge number 2000) crosses the IJhaven and connects the Piet Heinkade with Java-eiland in Amsterdam's Eastern Docklands. It was designed by the architect Ton Venhoeven and is named after the politician Jan Schaefer (1940-1994). Bus line 43 runs over the bridge.

name: Jan Swammerdambrug
en: The Jan Swammerdambrug (bridge 2291) is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam Oud-West. The bridge connects the Bilderdijkkade (the western bank of the Bilderdijkgracht) with the Tweede Constantijn Huygensstraat. It spans the Jacob van Lennepkanaal. Southwest of the bridge is the national monument WG-plein 500, the former main building of the Wilhelmina Gasthuis. v

name: Jan Swammerdambrug
en: The Jan Swammerdambrug (bridge 2291) is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam Oud-West. It connects the Bilderdijkkade, the west bank of the Bilderdijkgracht, with the Tweede Constantijn Huygensstraat, spanning the Jacob van Lennepkanaal. The national monument WG-plein 500, the former main building of the Wilhelmina Gasthuis, stands to its south-west.

name: Jan Tooropstraat
en: The Jan Tooropstraat is a street in Amsterdam Nieuw-West. The street is located in the Overtoomse Veld district and runs from Johan Jongkindstraat to Jan van Galenstraat.

name: Jan van Galenbrug
en: Bridge 382 is a bascule bridge located in Amsterdam-West. The traffic bridge (over which bus lines 18 and 80 also run) is located in Jan van Galenstraat and spans the Western Market Canal. The bridge is located just near the Centrale Markt (now called Foodcenter) which was opened in 1934.

name: Jan van Galenstraat
en: Brug 382 is a bascule bridge in Amsterdam-West. The traffic bridge, which also carries bus lines 18 and 80, lies in the Jan van Galenstraat and spans the Westelijk Marktkanaal. It stands close to the Centrale Markt, opened in 1934 and now called the Foodcenter, and was accordingly used by heavy freight traffic.

name: Jan van Galenstraat
en: Bridge 382 is a bascule bridge located in Amsterdam-West. The traffic bridge (over which bus lines 18 and 80 also run) is located in Jan van Galenstraat and spans the Western Market Canal. The bridge is located just near the Centrale Markt (now called Foodcenter) which was opened in 1934.

name: Jan van Galenstraat
en: The Jan van Galenstraat is a street in the Amsterdam neighborhoods of West and Nieuw-West. The street was named in 1925. It is named after the Dutch naval commander Jan van Galen (1604-1653) who died in the battle of Livorno against the English.

name: Jan van Scorelstraat
en: The Jan van Scorelstraat is a street in the Dutch city of Utrecht, which runs from the Adriaen van Ostadelaan to the Rembrandtkade and Stadhoudersbrug, after which it transitions into the Stadhouderslaan.

name: Jan van Zutphenplantsoen
en: The Jan van Zutphenplantsoen is a park and green strip in the Amsterdam district of Osdorp. The park is located in the southwestern part of the district west of the Hoekenesgracht, east of the Baden Powellweg, between the Slotervaart and the also named after Jan van Zutphen Jan van Zutphenstraat. The park and the street are with a

name: Jansbrug
en: The Jansbrug is a national monument arched bridge in the Utrecht city center that spans the Oudegracht. The bridge has one span and in the bridge abutments there are one or more bridge cellars. Adjacent to the Jansbrug are workshop cellars and yards. Around 1300 people could already cross the Oudegracht here. Around 1400 the market area extended in the

name: Janskerk
en: The Janskerk stands on the Janskerkhof in the Dutch city of Utrecht. It was founded shortly after 1040 by Bishop Bernold and dedicated to John the Baptist. It was one of the five chapter churches of the city in the Middle Ages (the others were the Cathedral, the Salvatorkerk, the Pieterskerk and the Mariakerk).

name: Janskerkhof
en: The Janskerkhof is a square in Utrecht, the capital of the Dutch province of Utrecht. It is the square on which the Janskerk and the former State Chamber (Brotherhood Monastery) stand. The Faculty of Law of the University of Utrecht, as well as the Faculty of Theatre of the University of the Arts Utrecht (HKU) are located on the Janskerkhof. Also the so

name: Jeremiebrug
en: The Jeremiebrug is a bridge in the Dutch city of Utrecht. The current bridge spans the Kruisvaart since 2012, just before the point where it flows into the Vaartsche Rijn. The previous Jeremiebrug from 1912, a municipal monument, has been located in the Máximapark in Vleuten since 2015.

name: Jeruzalemkerk
en: The Jeruzalemkerk is a Protestant church on the Jan Maijenstraat in the West borough of Amsterdam, in the De Baarsjes district near the Mercatorplein.

name: Jewish WW2 resistance memorial
en: The Monument Joods Verzet 1940-1945 is a monument in Amsterdam that has stood since 1988 on the corner of the Amstel and the Zwanenburgwal, beside the Stopera. It was raised in memory of all the Jewish resistance members who died in the Second World War, and is the work of the stonemason Joseph Glatt.

name: Jewish WW2 resistance memorial
en: The Monument to Jewish Resistance 1940-1945 is a monument in Amsterdam that has stood on the corner of the Amstel and the Zwanenburgwal, on the side of the Stopera since 1988. It was erected in memory of all Jewish resistance fighters who died in World War II. The resistance monument is the work of the stonemason/stonyware Joseph Glatt on the Put

name: Joep Langebrug
en: Joep Langebrug (bridge 417) is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-Zuid.

name: Joes Kloppenburgbrug
en: The Joes Kloppenburgbrug, bridge no. 5, is a slab bridge in Amsterdam-Centrum. It connects the Raamsteeg with the Oude Spiegelstraat and crosses the Singel. It is a relatively narrow and slightly humped bridge with three openings for shipping, decorated with a granite artwork.

name: Johan Cruijffbrug
en: The Johan Cruijffbrug (bridge 2238) is a structural work of art in the Dutch district of Amsterdam-Oost. The bridge is a pedestrian and bicycle bridge; it forms the connection between the Esplanade de Meer square and the Anfieldroad (street) towards Middenweg. It lies parallel to the Johan Neeskensbrug over a decorative water.

name: Johan Cruijffbrug
en: The Johan Cruijffbrug (bridge 2238) is a structure in the Amsterdam-Oost borough. It is a foot and cycle bridge connecting the Esplanade de Meer square with the Anfieldroad towards the Middenweg. It runs parallel to the Johan Neeskensbrug over an ornamental water in the Park de Meer neighbourhood in Watergraafsmeer.

name: Johan Huizingalaan
en: The Johan Huizingalaan in Amsterdam Nieuw-West is along the Oostoever, from Robert Fruinlaan to Nieuwe Haagseweg. Along the extension is Oude Haagseweg.

name: Johan Neeskensbrug
en: The Johan Neeskensbrug (bridge 2237) is a structure in Amsterdam-Oost. It is one of the few traffic bridges here — most are for slow traffic only — and lies in the Wembleylaan over an ornamental water in the Park de Meer neighbourhood in Watergraafsmeer, built between 1998 and 2002 and entirely surrounded by a ring ditch.

name: Johan Neeskensbrug
en: The Johan Neeskensbrug (bridge 2237) is a structural work of art in Amsterdam-Oost. The bridge is one of the few traffic bridges (most are only for slow traffic); it is located on Wembleylaan over a decorative water in the area near Park de Meer, Watergraafsmeer that rose from the ground here between 1998 and 2002.

name: Johan van Hasseltweg
en: Johan van Hasseltweg can refer to: Johan van Hasseltweg (street), a street in Amsterdam-North Noorderpark (metro station), a metro station in Amsterdam, formerly known as Johan van Hasseltweg

name: Johanna Borskibrug
en: The Johanna Borskibrug (bridge number 41) is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-Centrum. It lies in the Vijzelstraat and spans the Keizersgracht.

name: Johanneskerk
en: The Johanneskerk, also known as the Johannes Center, is a Protestant church building in the Overvecht district (Moezeldreef 400) in the Dutch city of Utrecht. The church is dedicated to the evangelist John.

name: John Rädeckerbrug
en: The John Rädeckerbrug (bridge 1916) is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-Oost. It lies in the Th. K. van Lohuizenlaan, called IJburglaan until 1998, and crosses the Lozingskanaal. Together with the similar Ad Grimmonbrug (bridge 1915) it connects the Zeeburg district with Cruquiuseiland; the two bridges share a history and an appearance.

name: John Rädeckerbrug
en: The John Rädeckerbrug (bridge 1916) is a permanent bridge in Amsterdam-Oost. It is located in the Th. K. van Lohuizenlaan, formerly called Ijburglaan until 1998 and crosses the Lozingskanaal. Together with the similar Ad Grimmonbrug (bridge 1915), it forms the connection between the Zeeburg district and the Cruquiuseiland.

name: Johnny & Jonesbrug
en: The Johnny & Jonesbrug (bridge 433) is a fixed bridge in the Prinses Irenebuurt in Amsterdam-Zuid. The footbridge crosses the entrance to the circular central pond of the Beatrixpark, beside the perennial garden. Jan Trapman's sculpture Pinguïns stands nearby. The park dates from 1936-1938.

name: Johnny & Jonesbrug
en: The Johnny & Jonesbrug (bridge 433) is a fixed bridge in the Prinses Irenebuurt in Amsterdam-Zuid. The pedestrian bridge is located over the entrance to the circular central large pond of Beatrixpark. It is located next to the "permanent botanical garden". In the immediate vicinity stands the sculpture Penguins by Jan Trapman.

name: Jonas Daniël Meijerplein
en: The Jonas Daniël Meijerplein, often abbreviated as J.D. Meijerplein, is a square in Amsterdam. On the north side, the square is bordered by Mr. Visserplein and on the south side by the Nieuwe Herengracht, near the Hortusplantsoen. The M.S. Vaz Dias Bridge connects the square to the Weesperstraat. The square is located on urban route S112.

name: Jonas Hamburger
en: The list of Stolpersteine in Utrecht (municipality) gives an overview of the commemorative stones that have been placed in the municipality of Utrecht in the Dutch province of Utrecht as part of the Stolpersteine project of the German sculptor-artist Gunter Demnig. Stolpersteine are dedicated to victims of Nazism, all those who were murdered by it.

name: Joods Monument Utrecht
en: The Joods monument in Utrecht is a memorial for the Jewish victims of World War II from Utrecht. Over 1600 people were deported in 1942 and 1943, only four hundred of them returned. Until 2015, Utrecht was the only major city in the Netherlands without a Joods monument, except for the Anne Frank statue on the Janskerkhof and a ge

name: Julianabrug
en: The Julianabrug is a monumental bridge in the Dutch city of Utrecht. It spans the Minstroom and forms a connection between the Adriaen van Ostadelaan and the Julianalaan. It is a fixed bridge with limited clearance height. The materials used are iron/steel, natural stone and brick. The Julianabrug is a municipal monument. The bridge dates back to

name: Julianapark
en: The Julianapark, named in 1939 after Princess Juliana, was a park but is now a residential area in Amsterdam Watergraafsmeer. The park was located north of Hugo de Vrieslaan, east of Amstel station and Julianaplein and was further enclosed by the Gooiseweg. The park was created after the opening of the Amstel station in 1939. Part of the park

name: Julianapark
en: The Julianapark is a city park near Julianapark and the surrounding area in the Northwest district of Utrecht. The 9.5 hectare park is bordered by the neighborhoods of Elinkwijk, Egelantier-, Mariëndaalstraat and surroundings, the Utrecht - Amsterdam railway line and the Amsterdamsestraatweg.

name: Julianaplein
en: The Julianaplein is a square in the Amsterdam neighborhood of Watergraafsmeer, Amsterdam-Oost, located near Amsterdam Amstel station.

name: Jutfaseweg
en: The Jutfaseweg is a street in the Dutch city of Utrecht in the Rivierenwijk district, which runs from the Vondellaan and the Westerkade to the Giessenplein and to the place where the Vaartsche Rijn and the Merwedekanaal meet. Parallel to the Jutfaseweg runs the Vaartsche Rijn.

name: Jutphasebrug
en: The Jutphasebrug (or Jutfase Bridge) is a bridge that connects the city of Utrecht and Nieuwegein. It spans the Amsterdam-Rhine Canal. Directly next to the bridge is a railway bridge for the Utrecht light rail; the Jutphasespoorbrug. In 1984, the steel deck was replaced by a concrete deck.

name: Jutphasespoorbrug
en: The Jutphasespoorbrug (or Jutfasespoorbrug) is a tram bridge that connects the city of Utrecht and Nieuwegein. It spans the Amsterdam-Rhine Canal and is part of the Sneltramlijn Utrecht – Nieuwegein / IJsselstein. The bridge is one of the few railway bridges of the tube bridge type, alongside the Suurhoffbrug, among others.

name: Kabouterbrug
en: The Kabouterbrug (Bridge 360) is a steel lift bridge in Amsterdam-Zuid that is only accessible to pedestrians and cyclists. The bridge is located on a continuous cycling route from Vondelpark via Schinkelhavenstraat towards Amsterdam Nieuw-West to Theophile de Bockstraat. It spans the Schinkel, which is part of the Staandemast route here, and connects d

name: Kabouterbrug
en: The Kabouterbrug (bridge 360) is a steel drawbridge in Amsterdam-Zuid, open only to pedestrians and cyclists. It lies on a through cycle route from the Vondelpark via the Schinkelhavenstraat towards Amsterdam Nieuw-West and the Theophile de Bockstraat. It spans the Schinkel, part of the Staandemastroute here.

name: Kadoelenbrug
en: The Kadoelenbrug (bridge 1787) is a bridge in Amsterdam-Noord. The name refers to the Kadoelen area north of the bridge. It was built between 29 August 2011 and May 2013 for just under 2.5 million euros, although the official opening took place on 4 July 2012.

name: Kamperfoelieweg
en: The Kamperfoelieweg is a street in Amsterdam-North.

name: Kanaalweg
en: Kanaalweg can refer to: Kanaalweg Kanaalweg (Delft) Kanaalweg (Leiden) Kanaalweg (Overcoat) Kanaalweg (Schoenebeek) Kanaalweg (Utrecht) Kanaalweg (Zwolle) Kanaalweg (water board)

name: Karspeldreef
en: The Karspeldreef is a dreef in the Bijlmermeer in Amsterdam-Zuidoost and runs from west to east just like the Bijlmerdreef and Daalwijkdreef.

name: Kasteel Oudaen
en: Oudaen is a fortified medieval house (also called a city castle) on the Oudegracht in the Dutch city of Utrecht. The building, with house number 99, is one of the most important monuments of the city.

name: Kattenburgerbrug
en: The Kattenburgerbrug (bridge 274) is a bascule bridge in Amsterdam-Centrum. The wide traffic bridge forms the connection between on one side the Prins Hendrikkade and the Kadijksplein (both southwest) and on the other side the Kattenburgerstraat, Kattenburgerplein and the Kattenburgergracht (northeast).

name: Kattenburgerbrug
en: The Kattenburgerbrug (bridge 274) is a bascule bridge in Amsterdam-Centrum. The wide traffic bridge connects the Prins Hendrikkade and the Kadijksplein to the south-west with the Kattenburgerstraat, Kattenburgerplein and Kattenburgergracht to the north-east. The boundary between the Oosterdok and the Nieuwe Vaart runs beneath it.

name: Kattenburgergracht
en: The Kattenburgergracht is a street in the center of Amsterdam that runs from Kattenburgerplein to Wittenburgergracht. North of Kattenburgerplein and canal lies the island of Kattenburg, on the southern side of it is the Nieuwe Vaart. With the Wittenburger and the Oostenburgergracht, which lie in each other's extension, the Kattenburgergracht

name: Kattenburgerplein
en: The Kattenburgerplein is a square in Kattenburg in Amsterdam-Centrum. It lies along the Prins Hendrikkade, opposite Kadijksplein, across the Kattenburgerbrug over the Nieuwe Vaart. From the square, traffic can continue onto the island of Kattenburg via Kattenburgerstraat, or via Kattenburgergracht to the other Eastern

name: Kattenburgerstraat
en: The Kattenburgerstraat is a street on the island of Kattenburg between Kattenburgerplein and the Marinierskade. Before the demolition of the buildings on Kattenburg, there were two narrow streets running parallel to each other here: the Grote Kattenburgerstraat and the Kleine Kattenburgerstraat.

name: Kattenrugbrug
en: De Katterug (bridge no. 1935) is a bridge over the Hugo de Grootgracht in Amsterdam-West. It connects the foot and cycle path continuing from the Van Reigersbergenstraat and the Hugo de Grootkade with the Bilderdijkpark, and lies in line with the Bilderdijkkade. It owes its name to its rather steep slope and profile, recalling a cat's back.

name: Kattenrugbrug
en: The Katterug (bridge no. 1935) is a bridge over the Hugo de Grootgracht in Amsterdam-West. The bridge connects the foot and bicycle path in connection with the Van Reigersbergenstraat and the Hugo de Grootkade to the Bilderdijkpark, and lies along the Bilderdijkkade. The bridge owes its name to its rather steep slope and profile, which is a bit steep

name: Kattensloot
en: The Kattensloot is a canal in Amsterdam-West, between the Singelgracht and the Kostverlorenvaart. Originally there was a narrow weather ditch, the Kattensloot. It is not certain where the name comes from, the name may refer to the name of the mill De Kat that stood on a nearby fortification.

name: Kattenslootbrug
en: The Kattenslootbrug (bridge 155) is a bascule bridge in Amsterdam-West.

name: Kees Fensbrug
en: The Kees Fensbrug (bridge number 49) is a permanent viaduct bridge in Amsterdam-Centrum. The bridge forms the connection between the Hartenstraat and Reestraat and spans the Keizersgracht. There has already been a bridge here for at least a century since the municipality of Amsterdam decided in 1881 that the bridge should be lowered.

name: Kees Fensbrug
en: The Kees Fensbrug (bridge number 49) is a fixed arched bridge in Amsterdam-Centrum. It connects the Hartenstraat with the Reestraat, spanning the Keizersgracht. A bridge had stood here for at least a century when the city decided in 1881 that it had to be lowered.

name: Keizersbrug
en: The Keizersbrug (bridge 286) is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-Centrum. The bridge is located along the extension of the Korte Koningsstraat and crosses the Oudeschans.
