en: The Van Diemenstraat is a street in the Zeeheldenbuurt of Amsterdam-Centrum. The street, which is part of the ring road s100, begins at Barentszplein in the east and ends at the Westerkeersluisbrug bridge that spans the Westerkanaal. The Van Diemenstraat is by the way the name of more streets in the Netherlands, named after Antonio van Diemen (1593-164

name: Van Eesteren Museum
en: The Van Eesteren Museum is a museum in Amsterdam Nieuw-West devoted entirely to the architect and town planner Cornelis van Eesteren. Since 22 October 2017 it has been housed in the Van Eesteren Paviljoen at Noordzijde 31.

name: Van Gendt Hallen
en: The Hallen van Stork, Van Gendthallen or Werkspoorhallen are five interconnected halls of the former Werkspoor-Stork factory in Oostenburg in Amsterdam. The buildings are located in the southwest corner of the former factory site, bordered by the Wittenburgervaart, the Oostenburgerdwarsvaart, the Oostenburgervaart and the railway lines between Centraal Stat

name: Van Hallbrug
en: Brug 171 is a bascule bridge in Amsterdam-West. It connects the Van Hallstraat with the Kostverlorenstraat, spanning the Kostverlorenvaart. That waterway is part of the Staandemastroute, so a fixed bridge is not possible here. Originally there was no intention to build a bridge at this spot.

name: Van Hallbrug
en: Bridge 171 is a bascule bridge in Amsterdam-West. It forms the connection between Van Hallstraat and Kostverlorenstraat and spans the Kostverlorenvaart. The Kostverlorenvaart is part of the Staandemast route, hence a fixed bridge is not possible here. Initially, it was not intended to build a bridge here, although

name: Van Heukelompark
en: The Van Heukelompark is a park in the Utrecht district of Zuilen. The park is named after the Utrecht architect George van Heukelom. Construction of the park began in 2012. The park still had the working name Springerpark at the time. The Van Heukelompark is a redesign of a park-like area that was known in official circles as the Van Heukelomlob.

name: Van Kinsbergenstraat
en: The Van Kinsbergenstraat is a street in the Chassébuurt of Amsterdam-West. The name refers to the Dutch naval officer Jan Hendrik van Kinsbergen (1735-1819). The Van Kinsbergenstraat was built in the 1920s. The western end of the street comes out at a footbridge over the Admiralengracht where a café was located. The eastern end of the

name: Van Mierlobrug
en: Van Mierlobrug (bridge 18) is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-Centrum. The traffic bridge connects the southern quay of the Blauwburgwal with the Herenstraat, spanning the Herengracht. It forms a whole with bridge 19, in the eastern quay of the Herengracht over the Blauwburgwal. It is surrounded by municipal and national monuments.

name: Van Mierlobrug
en: Van Mierlobrug (bridge 18) is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-Centrum. The traffic bridge connects the southern quay of the Blauwburgwal with Herenstraat. It spans Herengracht in the process. The bridge forms a whole with bridge 19 on the eastern quay of Herengracht and over the Blauwburgwal.

name: Van Nijenrodeweg
en: The Van Nijenrodeweg is a connecting street (access road) in the Amsterdam district of Buitenveldert and was named in 1958. The street is named after Gijsbrecht II of Nijenrode, bailiff of Amstelland, Waterland and Gooiland (1357-'58). Most of the access roads that were built around 1960 in Buitenveldert are named after historical bailiffs of

name: Van Noordtgracht
en: The Van Noordtgracht is a canal in the West district of Amsterdam. The name was established by council decision of November 20, 1878. The canal is named after Olivier van Noort (1558-1627), a explorer, who was the first Dutchman to circumnavigate the world via street Magelhaens from 1598 to 1601.

name: Varkenssluis
en: The Varkenssluis (bridge no. 204) is a bridge over the Oudezijds Voorburgwal in the Wallengebied area of Amsterdam. The bridge connects Damstraat with Oude Doelenstraat. A bridge has been lying here for centuries. It can already be seen on city maps by Pieter Bast (1599) and Balthasar Florisz. van Berckenrode (1625).

name: Varkenssluis
en: The Varkenssluis (bridge no. 204) is a bridge over the Oudezijds Voorburgwal in Amsterdam's Wallen district, connecting the Damstraat with the Oude Doelenstraat. A bridge has been here for centuries, appearing on the city maps of Pieter Bast (1599) and Balthasar Florisz. van Berckenrode (1625). It is named after the pig market held here around the 16th century.

name: Vecht
en: The Weerdsluis is a sluice gate with pointed doors in the Dutch city of Utrecht. It forms the connection between the Vecht and the Stadsbuitengracht. The sluice also has a flap door that was used to spill. The waterway is CEMT class II. The lock is 95.00 m long, the width is 8.00 m, the gate length is 82.00 m and the pool is 18.00 m wide.

name: Veebrug
en: The Veebrug (bridge 261) is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-Oost. It spans the Lozingskanaal and lies in the Veelaan, connecting the Zeeburgerpad with the Zeeburgerdijk. The Veelaan begins at the Cruquiusweg, crosses the Nieuwe Vaart by the Slachthuisbrug, and meets the Molukkenstraat across the Lozingskanaal.

name: Veebrug
en: The Veebrug (bridge 261) is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-Oost. It spans the Discharge Canal and is located in the Veelaan. It provides the connection between the Zeeburgerpad and the Zeeburgerdijk. The Veelaan begins at the Cruquiusweg, crosses the Nieuwe Vaart via the Slaughterhouse Bridge and connects to the Molukkenstraat across the Discharge Canal.

name: Veenderijbrug
en: The Veenderijbrug (bridge number 639) is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam Nieuw-West. The bridge is located in the Osdorperweg and spans the Osdorpervaart to the Osdorper Binnenpolder. There has been a bridge here since the 1920s, when the draining of the polder began. Initially this was a loading bridge, it was replaced in the 1940s by a boat

name: Veenderijbrug
en: The Veenderijbrug (bridge number 639) is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam Nieuw-West. It lies in the Osdorperweg and spans the Osdorpervaart towards the Osdorper Binnenpolder. A bridge has been here since the 1920s, when peat extraction in the polder began; the original drawbridge was replaced by a fixed bridge in the 1940s.

name: Veeneikbrug
en: The Veeneikbrug is a cycle and foot bridge connecting the Bijlmerweide in Amsterdam-Zuidoost to the west with the Diemerbos in Diemen to the east. It crosses the provincial road N236 on the Amsterdam side, the Gaasp and Weespertrekvaart, and the Stammerdijk on the Diemen side.

name: Veeneikbrug
en: The Veeneikbrug is a bicycle and pedestrian bridge that connects pedestrians and cyclists between the Bijlmerweide in Amsterdam-Zuidoost (west) and the Diemerbos in Diemen (east). The bridge crosses the Provincial road N236 (Amsterdam side), the Gaasp/Weespertrekvaart and the Stammerdijk (Diemer side). On the Amsterdam side it connects to the Gulde

name: Veilinghaven
en: The Veilinghaven (or Parkhaven) in the Dutch city of Utrecht is the former port of the Utrecht vegetable auction on the Merwedekanaal. Around this port, the eponymous residential area was developed between 1997 and 2014.

name: Veroneseplantsoen
en: The Veroneseplantsoen is a park in Amsterdam-Zuid, Oud-Zuid, Apollobuurt. The park was named after a council decision of October 31, 2017; after the painter Paolo Veronese. It is located between Veronesestraat (north), Raphaëlstraat (west), Gerrit van der Veenstraat (south) and Michelangelostraat (east), which were already in the 1920s

name: Viebrug
en: The Viebrug is a arched bridge in the Utrecht city center that spans the Oudegracht. Adjacent to the bridge are connecting workshops and yards. The former main post office is located next to Viebrug. The Lange Viestraat continues over the bridge into the Potterstraat. An old mention of the Viebrug dates back to 1289.

name: Vier Heemskinderenbrug
en: The Vier Heemskinderenbrug, also known as Vier Heemskinderensluis, is a permanent bridge in Amsterdam-Centrum. It is located on the western quay of the Herengracht and crosses the Leidsegracht. It has been a municipal monument since 1995 and is surrounded by national monuments.

name: Vier Heemskinderenbrug
en: The Vier Heemskinderenbrug, also called the Vier Heemskinderensluis, is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-Centrum. It lies in the western quay of the Herengracht and crosses the Leidsegracht. A municipal monument since 1995, it is surrounded by national monuments, one of which, Herengracht 394, has a wall stone under its middle first-floor window.

name: Vierwindstrekenbrug
en: The Vierwindstrekenbrug (bridge no. 381) is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-West.

name: Vikingrijn
en: The Vikingrijn is a newly excavated section of an original course of the Rhine River in the Máximapark in the municipality of Utrecht.

name: Vincentiuskerk
en: The Sint-Vincentiuskerk, named after patron saint Vincentius a Paulo, was a Catholic church building in Amsterdam Oud-West. The starting signal was given in July 1899 when the congregation purchased a 50 by 40 meter plot of land for a church and school.

name: Vlaams Cultuurhuis de Brakke Grond
en: De Brakke Grond, full name Vlaams Cultuurhuis de Brakke Grond, is a Flemish cultural center at Nes 45 in Amsterdam. The current building is a design by architect Arthur Staal. De Brakke Grond, located on a square in the middle of the theater district on the Nes, offers performances in the field of performing arts, visual arts, music and other forms of art

name: Vlaams Cultuurhuis de Brakke Grond
en: De Brakke Grond, in full Vlaams Cultuurhuis de Brakke Grond, is a Flemish cultural centre at Nes 45 in Amsterdam. The present building was designed by the architect Arthur Staal. Standing on a small square in the middle of the theatre district on the Nes, it presents performing arts, visual arts, music and other art forms.

name: Vleutense Wetering
en: The Vleutense Wetering is a watercourse in the western part of the Dutch municipality of Utrecht that is formed by part of the old course of the Rhine River. From the 8th century until around 1935, there was an artificial watercourse between the current city center and this river course, which was also sometimes called and was also known as Vleutense.

name: Vleutensespoorbrug
en: The Vleutensespoorbrug is the northernmost of the two railway bridges that connect the city of Utrecht with the Leidsche Rijn district. The bridge spans the Amsterdam-Rhine Canal and is part of the Utrecht-Rotterdam railway line.

name: Vleutensespoorbrug 2
en: The Vleutensespoorbrug 2 is the second railway bridge next to the Vleutense railway bridge. Like the Vleutense railway bridge, the bridge spans the Amsterdam-Rhine Canal and is part of the Utrecht-Rotterdam railway line. The bridge is located between the Hogeweide Bridge and the Vleutense railway bridge, on the site of the former Vleutense Bridge.

name: Vleutenseweg
en: The Vleutenseweg is a street in the Dutch city of Utrecht, which runs from the Westplein near Utrecht Central Station, via the Hogeweidebrug over the Amsterdam-Rhine Canal to the Leidsche Rijn district. Here the street connects to the Vleutensebaan.

name: Vlothaven
en: The Vlothaven is a port in the Amsterdam Western Port Area south of the Coenhaven, north of the Nieuwe Hemweg, east of the Einsteinweg and north of the Neptunushaven. The port is named after the raft. The port was dug in 1931 near the Mercuriushaven and provided space for ships and activities in the Eastern Harbor Area

name: Voetiusstraat
en: The Voetiusstraat is a street in the center of the Dutch city of Utrecht. It runs with a length of about 60 meters from the Domplein to the Pieterskerkhof. The street already existed around 1300. It was located around 1400 on the immunity of the Cathedral. Until his death in 1660, the painter Cornelis van Poelenburg lived in this then narrow alley. Ron

name: Volewijckbrug
en: The Volewijckbrug (bridge 2475) is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-Noord.

name: Vollersbrug
en: The Vollersbrug is a nationally protected arched bridge in the city center of Utrecht. The bridge spans the Oudegracht and has two spans. On the bridge border are workshop basements and yards. In the past, it was also sometimes referred to as the Volders Bridge. The name of the bridge is related to the volders who lived here.

name: Vondelbrug
en: The Vondelbrug (bridge 200) is a fixed bridge in the form of a viaduct in Amsterdam-Zuid, connecting Amsterdam Oud-Zuid with Amsterdam Oud-West.

name: Vondelbrug
en: The Vondelbrug is a fixed bridge in the form of a viaduct in Amsterdam-Zuid and connects Amsterdam Oud-Zuid with Amsterdam Oud-West.

name: Vondellaan
en: Vondellaan can refer to: Vondellaan (Baarn) Vondellaan 53 (Baarn) Vondellaan 55 (Baarn) Vondellaan (Groningen) Vondellaan (Hilversum) Vondellaan (Leiden) Vondellaan (Utrecht)

name: Vondelmonument
en: The Vondel monument, also known as the Vondelbeeld, is a large statue of the 17th-century Dutch poet and playwright Joost van den Vondel in the Vondelpark in Amsterdam. It was unveiled on 18 October 1867, after which the park itself came to be called the Vondelpark, which became its official name in 1880.

name: Vondelpark Open Air Theater
en: The Vondelpark Open Air Theatre in Amsterdam has staged concerts and performances every summer since 1974, by amateurs and professionals in cabaret, dance, children's theatre and music, in the heart of the Vondelpark. Admission is free, though a voluntary donation is requested.

name: Vondelpark Open Air Theater
en: The Vondelpark Open-Air Theater in Amsterdam has been organizing concerts and performances by amateurs and professional performers in the field of cabaret, dance, children's shows and music in the heart of Vondelpark every summer since 1974. The performances are free to attend, but a voluntary donation is requested. Every weekend in the months of June, July

name: Voorboezem
en: The Voorboezem is an old watercourse along the southern sea wall of the former island of Wieringen, near the Polder Waard-Nieuwland in Hollands Kroon in the Dutch province of North Holland.

name: Voorveldse Polder
en: Park de Voorveldse Polder is a park on the northeastern edge of the city of Utrecht. The park was reclaimed in the Middle Ages at the request of Bishop Godebald and is enclosed between the A27, Biltsestraatweg (N237), Sartreweg and the Biltse Rading. In the park is Fort De Bilt, one of the defensive works of the New Holland Water Line. In the seventies

name: Vredenburgplein
en: The Vredenburg, also known as Vreeburg, is a busy square in the Dutch city of Utrecht. It is also the name of the adjacent street, which connects Central Station with the old city center. The square is part of the shopping area in the center of Utrecht and borders the Hoog Catharijne shopping center. On three fixed days (Wednesday, Friday e

name: Vredeskerk
en: The Parish Church of Our Lady Queen of Peace or Vredeskerk is a Roman Catholic church between Pijnackerstraat and Van Hilligaertstraat in the southwest corner of the Pijp in Amsterdam-Zuid. The church has been the namesake of Vredeskerkplein since 2004.

name: Vrijburg
en: Diepenbrockstraat 46 is a church building on Diepenbrockstraat in Amsterdam-Zuid. The side facade is on Herman Gorterstraat. Here, between 1931 and 1933, a church building was erected for the Remonstrant Reformed Church in Amsterdam.

name: Vrijheidscarillon
en: The Vrijheidscarillon in Amsterdam is a clockwork toy that was manufactured in 1952 by the company A.H. van Bergen in Heiligerlee at the initiative of the Dutch Committee for National Commemoration. It hung in several places, including on the Dam in 1955. It was offered to the municipality of Amsterdam in 1960. This decided in late May of that year to c

name: Vrijheidscarillon
en: The Vrijheidscarillon in Amsterdam is a carillon made in 1952 by the firm A.H. van Bergen of Heiligerlee at the initiative of the Dutch national commemoration committee. It has hung in several places, including on the Dam in 1955, and was presented to the city of Amsterdam in 1960.

name: Vrijheidslaan
en: The Vrijheidslaan (formerly Amstellaan and Stalinlaan) is a main street in Amsterdam-Zuid, which together with the Berlagebrug forms the eastern entrance to the Rivierenbuurt. The avenue is an important main axis within the monumental urban planning Plan Zuid by architect Berlage and splits into two equal parts west of the Rijnstraat, on the Victorieplein.

name: VVJ
en: Football club Jaffa, also known as VVJ, is a Dutch amateur football club from the city of Utrecht, founded in 1931. The club is named after the Utrecht Machinefabriek Jaffa. VVJ plays at Sportpark Overvecht-Noord in the Utrecht district of Overvecht. The club's first team plays in the Fourth Division on Saturday (season 2020/21).

name: W.H. Vliegenbos
en: The W.H. Vliegenbos is located in Amsterdam-North, between Meeuwenlaan, Nieuwendammerdijk, Nieuwendammerkade and Zamenhofstraat. It is the oldest urban forest of the municipality of Amsterdam.

name: Waalseilandbrug
en: Bridge 283 is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-Centrum. The bridge over the Waalseilandsgracht forms the connection between the Lastage or Nieuwmarktbuurt and the Waalseiland. On the northeast side are the Buiten Bantammerstraat and the Binnenkant quay.

name: Waalseilandbrug
en: Brug 283 is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-Centrum. The bridge over the Waalseilandsgracht connects the Lastage, or Nieuwmarkt quarter, with the Waalseiland. The Buiten Bantammerstraat and the Binnenkant quay lie to the north-east, and the Binnen Bantammerstraat and the Lastageweg to the south-west.

name: Wachterliedplantsoen
en: The Wachterliedplantsoen is a park in the Bos en Lommer district in the Amsterdam municipality of West. The park, which was established in the early 1950s, is located between Egidiusstraat (west), Reinaert de Vosstraat (north), Heer Halewijnstraat (east) and Erasmusgracht (south). There is a pedestrian bridge over the canal to Erasmus Park. In 2010 is h

name: Wagon Litsbrug
en: Bridge 387 is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-Centrum. The bridge spans the Open Havenfront on the west side. It allows pedestrians and cyclists to cross from the west side of Stationsplein and the eastern quay of the Westertoegang to the Prins Hendrikkade at once. On the south side she lands on the foot and bicycle path of the Prins He

name: Wagon Litsbrug
en: Brug 387 is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-Centrum. It spans the western side of the Open Havenfront, letting pedestrians and cyclists cross in one go from the west side of the Stationsplein and the eastern quay of the Westertoegang to the Prins Hendrikkade, landing on the south side on that street's foot and cycle path.

name: Walenweeshuissluis
en: The Walenweessluis (bridge 70) is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-Centrum; sluis here means a stone bridge. It connects the Vijzelstraat with the filled-in Vijzelgracht, crossing the Prinsengracht. The name refers to the Walenweeshuis, the orphanage for children of the French or Walloon church.

name: Walenweeshuissluis
en: The Walenweessluis (bridge 70) is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-Centrum. Sluis stands for stone bridge here. The bridge forms the connection between Vijzelstraat and the canalized Vijzelgracht. It is located over the Prinsengracht. The name Walenweessluis is a name derived from the Walenweeshuis, the orphanage for children from the French or Walloon church.

name: Walk of Fame
en: The Walk of Fame in Utrecht is located in Vinkenburgstraat in the center of Utrecht. The Walk of Fame consists of bronze plaques with hand and footprints of celebrities from the film world. The Walk of Fame originated from the Dutch Film Festival, which also takes place annually in Utrecht. Together with the awarding of the prizes, the

name: Warmoesbrug
en: Warmoesbrug may refer to the Warmoesbrug in Amsterdam, bridge 22 and a national monument, or the Warmoesbrug in Delft.

name: Wasknijper
en: De Wasknijper (bridge 177) is a drawbridge in Amsterdam-Noord. The traffic bridge lies in the Distelweg and crosses the Buiksloterkanaal. It is the northernmost bridge over that canal.

name: waterdraagster
en: Waterdraagster met vissen is an artistic work in Amsterdam-West. A classical fountain originally stood in the garden of the Bellamyplein from 1905. The garden fell into disorder and the city cleared it; the fountain made way for a paddling pool designed by Ko Mulder, where neighbourhood children could splash from late summer 1954.

name: Waterlinieweg
en: The Waterlinieweg is a road, partly uneven, in the east of the city of Utrecht. The road owes its name to its location parallel to the Lunetten on the Houtense Vlakte, part of the Nieuwe Hollandse Waterlinie.

name: Wederkomst des Herenkerk
en: The Wederkomst des Herenkerk is a Roman Catholic church building on Marco Pololaan in the Kanaleneiland district in the Dutch city of Utrecht. The church is dedicated to the Return of the Lord. The church is used by the Martinus parish.

name: Wederkomst des Herenkerk
en: The Wederkomst des Herenkerk is a Roman Catholic church building on Marco Pololaan in the Kanaleneiland district in the Dutch city of Utrecht. The church is dedicated to the Return of the Lord. The church is used by the Martinus parish.

name: Weerdpoort
en: The Weerdpoort, also known as Amsterdamse Poort, was one of the four city gates of the city of Utrecht from the Middle Ages. The gate was located on the north side of the current city center, where the Oudegracht, the Stadsbuitengracht and the Utrechtse Vecht meet and today lies the Weerdbrug.

name: Weesbrug
en: The Weesbrug (formerly also Reguliersbrug) is a nationally protected arched bridge in the Utrecht city center. The bridge spans the Oudegracht. The bridge can only be used by pedestrians and cyclists. In the abutments of the bridge are bridge basements.

name: Weesperbrug
en: The Weesperbrug is a fixed steel arch bridge over the Amsterdam-Rijnkanaal and forms part of the provincial road N236.

name: Weesperplein
en: The Weesperplein is a square in the center of Amsterdam, between the Singelgracht and the Nieuwe Achtergracht. It connects the Weesperstraat via the Weesperpoortbrug to the Rhijnspoorplein in the direction of the Wibautstraat and is part of the Amsterdam city route s112, which connects the Gooiseweg to the IJtunnel.

name: Weesperstraat
en: The Weesperstraat is a street in Amsterdam-Centrum. The original buildings were demolished in the 1960s, after which the street was widened into a city highway, which connects J.D. Meijerplein with Weesperplein. The busy traffic road is part of the S112, which connects the IJtunnel and Mr. Visserplein via the Wibautstraat with the Gooiseweg. The s

name: Weespertrekvaart
en: The Weespertrekvaart is a canal that connects the Amstel in Amsterdam with the Vecht in Weesp. The canal was built in 1639, using several existing waterways: the ring canal of the Watergraafsmeer polder (constructed in 1629), the ring canal of the Bijlmermeer polder (constructed in 1626), the Gaasp river, and the ge

name: Weg der Verenigde Naties
en: The Weg der Verenigde Naties or Southern Ring Road is part of the ring road around Groningen and also part of Rijksweg 7. The road is about twelve kilometers long and runs from the Hoogkerk district to the Euvelgunne district. The road is important for the traffic flows between the city and the rest of the Netherlands but also for the passing car traffic.

name: Werk aan de Hoofddijk
en: Fort Hoofddijk was built in 1877-1879 east of Utrecht as part of the Nieuwe Hollandse Waterlinie. As a result of advances in artillery and explosives, the fort ring built around Utrecht in the 1820s had become outdated, and a new advanced ring of f was built in the 1870s.

name: Werkspoorbrug
en: The Werkspoorbrug is a railway bridge over the Amsterdam-Rhine Canal in Utrecht. The bridge is a steel-concrete arch bridge and was put into use in 2002. The span is 237 meters, making it the railway bridge with the second longest span in the Netherlands (the longest is the Zandhazenbrug near Muiderberg).

name: Wertheimpark
en: The Wertheimpark is a city park in the Plantagebuurt in Amsterdam.

name: West Indian Warehouse
en: The West Indian Warehouse in Amsterdam dates back to 1642 and is located on the western part of Rapenburg, where the Oudeschans flows into the Oosterdok. It was originally owned by the West Indian Company (WIC). The letters GWC on the facade stand for the official name, 'Geoctroyeerde West-Indische Compagnie'. Currently it has the monument status.

name: Westelijk Marktkanaal
en: The Westelijk Marktkanaal is a canal in Amsterdam-West. The name of the canal refers to the location of the canal relative to the Central Market Halls. The canal was put into use in 1934 for the opening and supply of the Central Market Halls. Today, most transport takes place by truck. Unlike the Kostv

name: Westerdoksdijk
en: The Westerdokseiland is an island in Amsterdam between the Westerdok and the IJ. It was created in 1832 when the Westerdoksdam was built, separating this part of the IJ and therefore no longer experiencing tides in the IJ, which was still in open connection with the Zuiderzee until 1870.

name: Westerdoksdijkspoorbrug
en: The Spoorbrug Westerdokseiland (bridge no. 19S) is a former railway bridge in Amsterdam. It connected the tracks of Centraal Station with the goods yard then on Westerdokseiland.

name: Westerdoksluis
en: The Westerdoksluis is a bascule bridge in Amsterdam-Centrum. It crosses the connection between the Westerdok and the IJ, carrying the Stadsroute 100 between the Westerdokskade and De Ruijterkade on the south side and the Westerdoksdijk on Westerdokseiland to the north.

name: Westerdoksluis
en: The Westerdoksluis is a bascule bridge in Amsterdam-Centrum.

name: Westergasbrug
en: The Westergasbrug (bridge 193) is an iron lifting bridge in Amsterdam-West. The bridge is not exactly along the extension of Van Limburg Stirumstraat, on the other side of its intersection with the Haarlemmerweg. It spans the Haarlemmervaart and provides access to the grounds of the former Westergasfabriek, its namesake.

name: Westerkanaal
en: The Westerkanaal is a canal in Amsterdam that connects the Singelgracht and the Haarlemmertrekvaart to the IJ, where the ships on the north side of the canal first have to cross the Oude Houthaven. The canal runs from the Singelgrachtbrug to Tasmanstraat/Van Diemenstraat. The western quay is interrupted by the Le Mairegracht and the Va

name: Westerkanaalschutsluis
en: The Westerkanaalschutsluis is a lock in the Westerkanaal, Amsterdam-West. They are located between both Houtmankades. The original lock was built from June 1877 (date of tender) in the then newly dug Westerkanaal, which formed a continuous route between the Singelgracht and the IJ. Large ships came in, so it became a fairly large sch

name: Westerkeersluis
en: The Westerkeersluis (bridge 346) is a bascule bridge in Amsterdam-West. The bridge spans the Westerkanaal and is part of the Centrumring S100. It connects Van Diemenstraat with Tasmanstraat. North of the bridge, the wooden sluice doors of the Westerkanaal water dam (sluice 205) between the city and the IJ are visible. The northern doors of that sluice l

name: Westerkeersluis
en: The Westerkeersluis (bridge 346) is a bascule bridge in Amsterdam-West. It spans the Westerkanaal and forms part of the S100 centre ring, connecting the Van Diemenstraat with the Tasmanstraat. North of the bridge stand the wooden gates of the Westerkanaal flood barrier (lock 205) between the city and the IJ.

name: Westerpark
en: The Westerpark is a park in Amsterdam-West, west of the Haarlemmerpoort and north of the Haarlemmertrekvaart.

name: Westertoegang
en: Westertoegang is a short canal (canal) in Amsterdam, between the IJ and the Singel.

name: Westertoren
en: The Westertoren in Amsterdam is the tower of the Westerkerk, at Prinsengracht 279 by the Westermarkt in Amsterdam-Centrum. The tower is owned by the city of Amsterdam. It was restored from February 2023 until early 2025.

name: Westerwijk
en: Westerwijk or Wester-wijk is a building in Amsterdam with houses, office space and two rooms. The building was built after a tender in June 1925 in 1925/1926 on the Admiraal de Ruyterweg to the design of F.B. Jantzen in the style of the Amsterdam School. The construction cost amounted to just under 80,000 guilders at the time.

name: Westhaven
en: The Westhaven is a port in the Western Port Area in Amsterdam and was built as part of the General Expansion Plan of 1934. The port is located west of the former Hembrug, on the south side of the North Sea Canal, in the former Groote IJpolder. The first part was dug in 1937 and was then called 'Fordhaven', after the nearby

name: Westkanaaldijk
en: Westkanaaldijk is a district in the north of the Lindenholt district in the Dutch city of Nijmegen. On January 1, 2023, the district had 5 residents, distributed over 5 houses, on an area of 1.22 km².

name: Westlandgracht
en: The Westlandgracht is a surface water, a street and until 1962 the name of a district and is named after the Westland, the area west of Delft and south of The Hague. The streets in the neighborhood are also named after places and regions in South Holland. The canal was named in 1933 and was built in the 1920s on the territory of the in

name: Westlandgrachtsluis
en: The Westlandgrachtsluit, also known as Westlandgrachtsluis, is a sluice gate in Overtoomse Veld in Amsterdam Nieuw-West.

name: Westplein
en: Westplein can refer to:"Westplein", the former name of the "Heroes of the Seaport Square" in Den Helder, renamed after the establishment of a monument for Dorus Rijkers after 1928. Westplein (Rotterdam), a square near the Veerhaven in the Shipping Quarter in Rotterdam. Westplein (Utrecht), a traffic square on the west side of Utrecht Central Station.

name: Westpoortweg
en: The Westpoortweg is an important continuous connection between Amsterdam Westpoort and the North Sea Canal and further towards Velsen-Zuid. The road extends from Luvernes but is in fact the extension of the North Sea Road which at the junction with Luvernes makes a right turn and then again a left turn. The road continues in an S-shape along d

name: Weteringpoort
en: The Weteringpoort was one of the eight Amsterdam city gates built during the third and fourth expansions. Part of the city's fortifications, it was, with the Raampoort and the Zaagmolenpoort, one of the smaller gates. Besides a passage with a wooden bridge it also had a waterway opening connecting the Lijnbaansgracht.

name: Weteringpoort
en: The Weteringpoort was one of the eight Amsterdam city gates that were built during the third and fourth explanations. The Weteringpoort, which was part of the fortifications of Amsterdam, was one of the smaller city gates together with the Raampoort and Zaagmolenpoort.

name: Weteringpoort
en: The Water Management Lock (lock 209) is a lock in the center of Amsterdam between Lijnbaansgracht and Singelgracht. The lock dates back to 1657 when two passages into the city were built in the Schans; the other was the Leidsepoortsluis (demolished in 1880).

name: Wethouder Frankeweg
en: Wethouder Frankeweg is a street in Amsterdam-Oost.

name: Wibautstraat
en: The Wibautstraat is a street in Amsterdam-Oost, between the Rhijnspoorplein and the Prins Bernhardplein and named after former alderman Floor Wibaut.

name: Wiegbrug
en: The Wiegbrug (bridge no. 173) is a movable bridge over the Kostverlorenvaart in Amsterdam-West, connecting the De Clercqstraat with the Admiraal de Ruijterweg. Its name refers to the type of bridge built here in 1904, a rolling bascule bridge.

name: Wijttenbachstraat
en: The Wijttenbachstraat is a street in the Dapperbuurt in Amsterdam-Oost, between the corner Oosterpark-Linnaeusstraat and the railway viaduct near Pontanusstraat. The street was laid out in the 1880s and was named in 1882, after the eighteenth-century professor Daniël Wyttenbach. The first houses in the street were built for the officers in the nearby

name: Wil de Graaffbrug
en: The Wil de Graaffbrug (bridge 393) is a pedestrian bridge in Amsterdam-West. The bridge is located in the northeast of Erasmus Park and spans the Erasmusgracht, which is just outside the park. The bridge extends from the Lof der zotheid bridge (bridge 394). The bridge dates back to 1970, when the park was completely redesigned for a lot of money at the time.

name: Wil de Graaffbrug
en: The Wil de Graaffbrug (bridge 393) is a footbridge in Amsterdam-West. It lies in the north-east of the Erasmuspark and spans the Erasmusgracht, which runs just outside the park, in line with the Lof der zotheidbrug (bridge 394). It dates from 1970, when the park was completely relaid at what was then great expense.

name: Wilhelminakerk
en: The Wilhelminakerk is a church building in the Dutch city of Utrecht. The church building was built around 1931 in the Schildersbuurt on the corner of Hobbemastraat and Paulus Potterstraat. The design in the style of the Amsterdam School comes from the architect H.F. Mertens. The building is valued as a municipal monument.

name: Wilhelminapark
en: The Wilhelminapark is a city park in the Dutch city of Utrecht. It is recognized as a national monument as one of the first parks in the Netherlands. The park is centrally located in Utrecht-Oost and east of Oudwijk. The surrounding neighborhood is called the Wilhelminaparkbuurt while a street along the park is also called Wilhelminapark.

name: Willem de Zwijgerkerk
en: The Willem de Zwijgerkerk is a Protestant church on Olympiaweg in Amsterdam-Zuid. It is a "neighborhood church" of the Protestant Church (PKN) in Amsterdam.

name: Willemsbrug
en: The Willemsbrug (bridge 151) is a bridge in Amsterdam-West over the Singelgracht between the Haarlemmerplein and the Nassauplein. This bascule bridge is named after the nearby Willemspoort. The construction of a bridge at this location became necessary after the construction of the Westerkanaal in 1877.

name: Willemsbrug
en: The Willemsbrug (bridge 151) is a bridge in Amsterdam-West over the Singelgracht between the Haarlemmerplein and the Nassauplein. This bascule bridge is named after the nearby Willemspoort. A bridge became necessary here after the Westerkanaal was dug in 1877. The present bridge is a 1925 design by Piet Kramer, built in 1928.

name: Wim Sonneveldbrug
en: The Wim Sonneveldbrug (bridge 175) is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-Centrum. It lies in the Marnixstraat and spans the Leidsegracht. It was placed in 1935/1936 to a plain design by Piet Kramer, with no ornament or sculpture.

name: Wim Suurbierbrug
en: The Wim Suurbierbrug (bridge 2239) is a structural work of art in Amsterdam-Oost. The bridge is one of the traffic bridges (the others are for slow traffic) that forms the connection within the Park de Meer neighborhood within the Watergraafsmeer, which rose from the ground here between 1998 and 2002.

name: Wim Suurbierbrug
en: The Wim Suurbierbrug (bridge 2239) is a structure in Amsterdam-Oost. It is one of the traffic bridges — the others are for slow traffic — within the Park de Meer neighbourhood in the Watergraafsmeer, built here between 1998 and 2002 and entirely surrounded by a ring ditch.

name: Witte Boogbrug
en: The Witte Boogbrug (bridge 469), named after its appearance, is a structure in Amsterdam-Noord. It lies in the Monnikendammerweg and spans a local pond. It was built as a viaduct, designed in the mid-1960s as part of the crossing of the Monnikendammerweg and the Zuiderzeeweg.

name: Witte Boogbrug
en: The Witte Boogbrug (bridge 469), named after its appearance, is a work of art in Amsterdam-Noord. It is located on Monnikendammerweg. It spans a local pond. The bridge was built as a viaduct. It was designed in the mid-1960s as part of the intersection of the Monnikendammerweg and the Zuiderzeeweg. This Zuiderzeeweg would pass through the Amsterdamsebrug

name: Wittevrouwenbrug
en: The Wittevrouwenbrug is a fixed bridge in the Dutch city of Utrecht. It is located on the northeast side of the city center and forms in particular a direct connection between the Biltstraat and the Wittevrouwenstraat. The waterway that crosses it is the Stadsbuitengracht. This former defensive canal around the city was from the Middle Ages until the

name: Yaa Adu-Ampomabrug
en: The Yaa Adu-Ampomabrug, called the Reigersbospadbrug until 2023, is a structure in Amsterdam-Zuidoost.

name: Zaagpoort
en: The Zaagpoort (bridge no. 161) is a fixed bridge between the center of Amsterdam and the Amsterdam-West district. The bridge connects on the one hand Marnixplein and Marnixstraat on the other hand Frederik Hendrikplantsoen and Nassaukade. It crosses the Singelgracht.

name: Zaagpoort
en: De Zaagpoort (bridge no. 161) is a fixed bridge between the centre of Amsterdam and the Amsterdam-West borough. It connects the Marnixplein and Marnixstraat on one side with the Frederik Hendrikplantsoen and Nassaukade on the other, crossing the Singelgracht. The covered Marnixbad stood beside it before it was demolished and replaced.

name: Zaanlijn
en: The Zaanlijn is the Uitgeest-Amsterdam section of the Den Helder-Amsterdam railway. It runs through the Zaanstreek and takes its name from the fact that much of the line runs parallel to the river Zaan.

name: Zandbrug
en: The Zandbrug is a nationally protected arched bridge in the Utrecht city center. The late medieval bridge spans the Oudegracht. North of the Zandbrug is the access to the Stadsbuitengracht and the Vecht river with the Weerdsluis at the Bemuurde Weerd. Directly adjacent to the south side of the bridge are workshop basements and yards.

name: Zanzibarhaven
en: The Zanzibarhaven is a port in the Amsterdam Western Port Area east of the Westpoortweg and west of the Afrikahaven.

name: Zebrabrug
en: The Zebrabrug is a structure in Amsterdam and a temporary structure in Leiden.

name: Zeeburgerbrug
en: The Zeeburgerbrug (no bridge number) is a traffic bridge over the Buiten IJ and Amsterdam-Rhine Canal in Amsterdam. The bridge connects the Zeeburgereiland (Amsterdam-Oost) and the Watergraafsmeer. The Zeeburgerbrug carries the A10 with two lanes of three lanes plus two weaving lanes. It is not accessible to pedestrians and cyclists; they must use

name: Zeeburgerbrug
en: The Zeeburgerbrug, which has no bridge number, is a traffic bridge over the Buiten IJ and the Amsterdam-Rijnkanaal in Amsterdam, connecting Zeeburgereiland in Amsterdam-Oost with the Watergraafsmeer. It carries the A10 with three lanes plus two weaving lanes each way, and is closed to pedestrians and cyclists.

name: Zeeburgerdijk
en: The Zeeburgerdijk is a dike in Amsterdam-Oost. The Zeeburgerdijk extends along the Hoogte Kadijk and continues beyond the Amsterdam-Rhine Canal into the Diemerzeedijk. The former district of Zeeburg took its name from the Zeeburgerdijk and the Zeeburgereiland.

name: Zeilbrug
en: The Zeilbrug or Zeilstraatbrug (bridge no. 348) is a bridge over the Schinkel in Amsterdam. It connects the Zeilstraat with the Hoofddorpweg, linking Oud-Zuid with the Hoofddorppleinbuurt. Various city documents mention only bridge 348; Zeilbrug was apparently never an official name.

name: Zeilbrug
en: The Zeilbrug or Zeilstraatbrug (bridge no. 348) is a bridge over the Schinkel in Amsterdam. The bridge connects Zeilstraat and Hoofddorpweg and forms a connection between Oud-Zuid and the Hoofddorpplein neighborhood. Various documents from the municipality of Amsterdam only mentioned bridge 348; Sail Bridge was apparently not an official name.

name: Zeilstraat
en: The Zeilstraat is a street in Amsterdam-Zuid, between the Amstelveenseweg and the Schinkel. The Zeilstraat is known as a busy, main shopping street. It extends along the Koninginneweg.

name: Zevenblad
en: Zevenblad is a perennial plant from the Apiaceae family. The plant grows in shady places in hedges, gardens, roadside verges and field edges in moist or fertilized soil. The plant is also called hen comb, gardener's grief and heers.

name: Zigeunermonument - Hel en Vuur
en: The Roma memorial Hel en vuur on the Museumplein in Amsterdam is a bronze sculpture of a man, a woman and two children fleeing a flaring fire. It stands on a brick plinth and is 3.50 m high. It was made by the sculptor Heleen Levano, and the text on the plinth comes from a Roma and Sinti prayer for the dead.

name: Zijkanaal F
en: Zijkanaal F has been a canal in the Dutch province of North Holland since 1873. It is a branch of the North Sea Canal. From Halfweg, the North Sea Canal could be reached via the side canal F. This side canal was also an important drainage of the Halfweg steam pumping station of the High Authority of the Rhine-Westphalia to the North Sea Canal.

name: Zijkanaal H
en: The Zijkanaal H is a side channel of the North Sea Canal and connects the Barndegat on the border of Amsterdam and Zaandam to the North Sea Canal. The canal was put into use in 1876 simultaneously with the North Sea Canal. It is, viewed from IJmuiden, the eighth side channel.

name: Zijkanaal I
en: The Zijkanaal I (with the letter "I") is a waterway in Amsterdam-North. It forms the connection between the IJ in Amsterdam and the former Oostzaner Overtoom near Oostzanerwerf. The eastern and northeastern banks of the canal lie along the Buiksloterdijk, the Landsmeerderdijk and a section of the Oostzanerdijk, which are part of the historic Wat

name: Zimmerterrein
en: The Zimmerterrein, also known as the Landje van Ome Kick, is a small park in the Bellamy neighborhood in Amsterdam-West. The park is located on the east side of the Kostverlorenvaart near the Wiegbrug. On the north side the park borders Tolbrugstraat and on the south side Schimmelstraat. The site forms a break in the Tweede Kostverlorenkade. the

name: Zocherstraat
en: The Zocherstraat is a street in Amsterdam-West. The street was named on October 10, 1915, after the landscape architect Louis Paul Zocher, who died on September 7, 1915, and together with his father Jan David Zocher designed the Vondelpark. The naming of the street took place when construction was already underway. Also Leiden, Rotterdam e

name: Zorgvliedsluis
en: The Zorgvliedsluis or Zorgvliedschutsluis is a lock in the Nieuwe Wetering near the Zuidelijke Wandelweg in Amsterdam. On the east side of the lock lies a branch of the Nieuwe Wetering that has open connection with the Amstel at the Zorgvliedbrug.

name: Zouthavenbrug
en: The Willem Breukerbrug (bridge 2326) is a structure in Amsterdam-Centrum. Until 10 January 2024 it was called the Zouthavenbrug.

name: Zuider Amstelkanaal
en: The Zuider Amstelkanaal is a canal in Amsterdam-Zuid. The canal was dug as part of the Plan Zuid by architect H.P. Berlage and is part of the connection between the Amstel and the Schinkel. It forms the separation between Stadionbuurt and Apollobuurt and the Prinses Irenebuurt.

name: Zuiderkerk Tower
en: The Zuidertoren is the tower of the Zuiderkerk in Amsterdam.

name: Zuiderkerkhof
en: Zuiderkerkhof is an indoor square in Amsterdam-Centrum, Zuiderkerkbuurt.

name: Zuiderzeeweg
en: The Zuiderzeeweg is the name of a number of Dutch roads, including in Amsterdam and Middenmeer. The name refers to the former Zuiderzee. The Zuiderzeeweg in Amsterdam connects Amsterdam-Oost with Amsterdam-North.

name: Zuiderzeeweg
en: The Amsterdamsebrug (bridge 54P) is a fixed arch bridge carrying the Zuiderzeeweg over the Amsterdam-Rijnkanaal, between the Zeeburgerdijk in Amsterdam-Oost and Zeeburgereiland. Beyond it the road continues on a concrete fixed bridge that curves left onto Zeeburgereiland, followed by the Schellingwouderbrug.

name: Zuidplein
en: The Zuidplein in Amsterdam-Zuid is the forecourt of Amsterdam Zuid station. The square is located in the Zuidas area. On the other side of Station Zuid is Gustav Mahlerplein. The square was already planned in 1917 in the Zuid plan by H.P. Berlage as a large forecourt of a large Zuid station. Only 61 years later, on December 20, 1978, the laa

name: Zwarte Water
en: The Zwarte Water is an ancient watercourse in the Dutch city of Utrecht that flows into the Vecht River. The watercourse is located near Lauwerecht. At the height of the Vecht, the national monument Lauwerecht Bridge spans the Zwarte Water as a watercourse. The street on the north side is called Zwartewater and it continues into the Vogelenbuurt.
